6793841238.name: Rivals: Padel Scores & Stats
6793841238.description: The court is booked. Rivals is everything the booking is for. Your crew already has a competitive life — standings nobody writes down, a rivalry nobody names, a greatest-comeback-ever that survives only in retellings. Rivals gives it a home: every set logged, every rating earned, every season engraved. RUN THE NIGHT Open a night with one poll — where, when, how many spots. The crew claims them; the night locks when it fills. Or tap Play Now, pick who showed up, and start logging. Fair pairings generated for you. Courtside live scoring — 15, 30, 40 — with undo, golden point or advantage, your call at the start. Confirm the match once, fix mistakes for 24 hours, then it is history. A RATING THAT STAYS IN THE CREW Your rating lives inside your crew — nowhere else. No global number to protect, no reason to duck a match. It is margin-aware, honest about rotating pairs, and it always shows its work: tap any change and see exactly why. THE MEMORY ENGINE Boards for rating, points, best pair, most improved and attendance. Head-to-head records for every pair of players. Belts to take and defend. A records book that remembers the night someone won 12 straight. Seasons that end in a ceremony — a champion, a wooden spoon, and a year in review the whole crew relives. BUILT FOR REAL CREWS The captain runs the roster; everyone else just plays. Add your crew by name in seconds — each spot stays open until its player claims it with an invite link. Guests welcome on casual nights. Tactics board with animated 2v2 plays — study the game between nights. Fee ledger for court money. Calendar export. Home-screen widgets, Live Activity, a TV scoreboard mode and an Apple Watch scorer. Works courtside with no signal — everything syncs when you are back. In 26 languages. FREE, AND WHAT CREW PRO ADDS Free is one crew of up to four players — a full court — and nothing inside it is metered: unlimited matches, live scoring, ratings, boards, belts, records and your year in review, kept forever. No ads. Crew Pro lifts the caps — a bigger roster, more than one crew — and adds history import, weekly digests, printable season volumes, advanced analytics and crest packs. One subscription covers the whole crew. Your crew's whole competitive life, in one place. The lights are on. Now settle who is really the best. Privacy policy - https://getrivals.app/privacy Terms of Service - https://getrivals.app/terms

6791810966.name: 图易 - 本地图片处理工具箱
6791810966.trackName: 图易 - 本地图片处理工具箱
6791810966.description: 图易是一款专为 iPhone 打造的本地图片处理工具箱。 它充分利用 iPhone 设备本身的处理能力，让压缩、比例裁剪、调尺寸、转格式、图片拼接、宫格裁剪、全景切片、隐私马赛克和清除图片元数据等日常图片处理任务，都可以直接在手机本地完成。 不上传图片，不需要账号，没有广告和复杂功能。这样可以减少图片上传带来的隐私风险，也能在离线或网络不稳定时继续处理常用图片任务。 图易适合这些场景： 图片太大，想压缩后发送 HEIC 图片需要转成 JPEG 想把多张图片横向或纵向拼接 想把一张图片切成 2、3、4、6 或 9 宫格 发图前想裁剪成合适比例 截图里有手机号、头像或聊天信息，需要打码 照片里包含 GPS 位置或拍摄信息，想清除后再分享 核心功能： 【图片压缩】 快速减小图片体积，支持单张和批量处理。 【调整尺寸】 按比例缩小图片分辨率，保持原始宽高比。 【格式转换】 支持 HEIC、JPEG、PNG 等常见格式转换。 【图片裁剪】 支持 1:1、4:5、16:9、9:16 和原图比例裁剪。 【图片拼接】 将最多 5 张图片按横向或纵向拼成一张新图片。 【宫格裁剪】 把一张图片切成 2、3、4、6 或 9 宫格。 【全景切片】 将宽幅图片切成连续多张图片。 【隐私打码】 本地识别人脸和文字区域，默认使用马赛克遮挡。 【清除图片信息】 清除照片中的 GPS 位置、拍摄设备、拍摄时间等信息。 为什么选择图易： 图片只在你的 iPhone 上处理 利用 iPhone 本机能力完成处理 不上传图片 可离线处理常用图片任务 不需要账号 不接入广告 不做订阅 不默认扫描相册 一次买断，干净使用 图易不是复杂修图软件，而是一个打开就能用的日常图片工具箱。 让常用图片处理，更简单。

6615060994.name: Surreal Machines Crack
6615060994.description: Crack is a workhorse of a plugin. It’s great on just one drum or for quickly adjusting a loop and is cheap on your CPU so you can load it up across all your tracks. Its other advantage is that it can be blended with the dry signal using the Dry/Wet knob, so you can dial in the amount of the effect. Crack features a custom limiter for peak reduction, soft analog-modeled clipping, and a maximizer specially tuned for use with transient materials. Control of Attack and Sustain (Release section) Post Soft Clipper, Limiter or Maximizer Dry/Wet Mix for parallel processing Crack is an Audio Unit V3 plugin; it benefits from an AUV3 host like Logic, GarageBand, Cubasis, AUM, etc.

6761165330.name: Soulo - 多平台搜索浏览器
6761165330.trackName: Soulo - 多平台搜索浏览器
6761165330.description: 搜罗 Soulo — 一键搜遍全球平台 搜罗是一款聚合搜索引擎，内置40+搜索平台，输入一次关键词，左右切换即可对比不同平台的搜索结果。 【聚合搜索】 Google、百度、YouTube、B站、淘宝、京东、GitHub、知乎、微博——一个App全搞定，无需逐个打开浏览器。 【AI搜索】 集成DeepSeek、通义千问、豆包、腾讯元宝、Perplexity、Phind、You.com等AI搜索引擎，一键获取AI智能分析结果。 【自定义平台】 任何支持URL搜索的网站都可以添加为平台。支持批量导入JSON配置，轻松扩展影视、学术、购物等垂直搜索场景。 【自定义分组】 创建分组归类管理平台，搜索时快速切换不同分组，打造专属搜索工作流。 【语音搜索】 支持8种语言语音输入，解放双手即可搜索。 【广告拦截】 内置广告屏蔽引擎，自动拦截搜索页面中的广告内容，搜索更清爽。 【跨语言搜索】 智能检测关键词语言，建议翻译后在对应地区平台搜索，拼写纠错自动检测。 【隐私保护】 无账号体系，无数据上传，搜索历史和收藏仅保存在本地设备。支持隐身模式，不留痕迹。 【更多功能】 收藏网页，支持Spotlight和Siri快速访问 Bing每日壁纸自动更换 下拉刷新、左右滑动前进后退 支持iPad横屏 8种语言界面：中文、英语、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、越南语

6792587132.name: OktaDie - Symbiotic Synth
6792587132.description: Eight touch-sensitive voices, a cross-modulation matrix, a dual modulated delay and an overdrive - with no keyboard, no scale and no quantisation anywhere in the signal path. OktaDie is not a subtractive synth with a fancy front panel: it is a machine that responds to touch, drifts on its own, and never produces exactly the same sound twice. Inspired by the legendary analogue "organismic synthesizer", OktaDie follows the same philosophy: the envelope is part of the oscillator, not a VCA after it; noise, bleed and crosstalk are features, not defects; and every position of every control is designed to produce a usable soundscape. PLAYED BY TOUCH Eight multitouch pads replace the keyboard. Play them with several fingers at once, slide sideways to glide from one pad to the next. How hard you press matters: iOS does not measure finger force, so OktaDie reads the contact area of your fingertip - press harder, more skin touches the glass, the envelope opens further. Apple Pencil pressure is used directly where available. Choose POSITION, AREA or BOTH under SETUP. THE VOICES Eight non-linear generators, closer to a vintage electric organ than to a VCO. TUNE moves each voice continuously across a huge range, untempered and unquantised. SHARP morphs the waveform from triangle to square. The envelope shapes pitch and waveform as it moves, and weighs how much the voice contributes to the FM matrix. Independent drift on every voice means two instances never sit perfectly in tune. CROSS-MODULATION Voices work in four pairs and two groups. Each pair picks its modulation source: another pair, the Hyper LFO, or the instrument's own output. One switch reroutes the whole matrix into a single closed FM loop across all eight voices. TOTAL FB feeds the post-distortion output back in, turning the entire instrument - envelopes, delay and drive included - into one giant FM structure. HYPER LFO Two LFOs combined by an AND/OR formula, plus a link that lets the first modulate the second. It drives the voice pairs and the delay. MOD DELAY AND DRIVE Two delay lines with cross-feedback, each with its own time and modulation depth. Times follow the Hyper LFO or the lines' own output. Push the feedback past halfway and the delay self-oscillates into an instrument of its own. Lo-fi and noisy by design, dirtier as the times stretch. A drive stage with parallel mix closes the chain. ON YOUR DEVICE Standalone app plus two AUv3 extensions: OktaDie as an instrument, OktaDie FX as an effect that runs your own audio through the delay, drive and feedback loop. Works in AUM, GarageBand, Cubasis, Drambo, Logic for iPad and any AUv3 host. 61 factory presets, plus your own. Preset files are shared with the desktop version. Portrait and landscape, pinch to zoom, fine adjustment by sliding a knob sideways, long-press for MIDI learn, double-tap to reset. MIDI notes, velocity, aftertouch and MPE, pitch bend and CC1 vibrato depth. No account, no subscription, no internet connection required. OktaDie is inspired by the SOMA Laboratory LYRA-8. It is an original, independent software instrument: not licensed, authorised or endorsed by SOMA Laboratory, and in no way affiliated with or connected to it. It contains no code, circuit designs, samples or graphics originating from SOMA Laboratory. SOMA, SOMA Laboratory and LYRA-8 are trademarks of their respective owner, used here for descriptive purposes only.

6794986363.description: 企鹅训练是一款简洁高效的健身训练记录工具，帮助你系统规划训练、记录每组重量和次数，见证每一步成长。 【动作库】 内置 30+ 常见健身动作，涵盖胸、背、腿、肩、手臂、核心六大肌群，每个动作配有 GIF动画演示和详细要领说明。 【训练记录】 训练时轻松记录每个动作的组数、重量和次数，自动保存训练历史，随时回顾过往表现。 【智能计划】 根据你的训练水平（入门 / 进阶 / 硬核）自动生成每周训练计划，支持自定义模板，灵活调整适合自己的节奏。 【数据本地存储】 所有数据存储在本地，不上传任何信息，充分保护你的隐私。

6792442577.name: 涨记 - 净资产K线
6792442577.description: 涨记把你的净资产，画成一张会呼吸的 K 线图。 像看股票一样看自己的钱——今天是阳线还是阴线，这个月是涨是跌，一眼看清。 【核心】 净资产 K 线：每天的资产变化连成蜡烛，红涨绿跌可切换，日 / 周 / 月自由缩放 三秒记一笔：内置计算器，账户和分类一次选好 账户卡册：现金、银行卡、信用卡集中一处，自动算出净资产 复盘：月度趋势、分类占比、预算执行，钱去哪了一目了然 【隐私优先】 数据只在你手机里，不联网、无账号、不收集任何信息 没有广告，没有推送；买断制，一次付费 【从其他记账 App 搬家】 已经在用别的记账 App？把导出的账单交给任意 AI 转换成统一格式，粘贴或选文件就能一次导入，几年的记录不用手动重录。 【顺手的小工具】 主屏小组件：净资产和今日涨跌，抬手就看见 长按图标，快速记一笔 涨记不追求大而全，只把一件事做到极致：让你像看盘一样，看着自己的资产慢慢长大。

6795860079.description: 台风许愿机是一款集台风追踪与趣味互动于一体的创意天气应用。接入和风天气官方数据，为你实时呈现西太平洋台风动态。 查看当年所有台风列表与详细信息，包括风力等级、气压、移动方向等关键数据，随时掌握台风最新动态。 【地图可视化】 在地图上直观展示台风当前位置、历史路径与预测轨迹，台风走向一目了然。 【趣味许愿】 选择愿望方向和法器道具，向真实台风许愿！风铃、龙珠、妈祖符、千纸鹤、雷鼓——五大法器各有神通。纯属娱乐，为台风季增添乐趣。 【创意台风】 创建属于你自己的虚拟台风，在地图上观察它的移动轨迹。 【像素美学】 精心设计的复古像素艺术界面，搭配Q版卡通台风动画，带来独特的视觉体验。 温馨提示：许愿功能纯属娱乐，不会对真实台风产生任何影响。请关注官方气象预警，做好防台安全措施。

6772933367.name: LeaseKeeper：租约档案
6772933367.description: 租约档案是一款默认本地保存的租房记录工具，同时适合租客和房东使用。 你可以用它快速记录入住、退租、交房、收房、退房检查、清洁和维修等场景，而不用把流程变成复杂的房产管理系统。 在 2.0 版本中，你可以： 快速创建带照片、备注和检查项的房屋报告 为同一套房屋建立长期保存的租约档案 记录租客身份证明、房东身份证明、合同图片和其他资料 保存入住/交房与退租/收房时的房屋情况留档 核验水、电、燃气等交接读数 记录家具家电清单、状态备注和照片 导出清晰的 PDF 报告，便于留证和分享 在设备内设置本地租金提醒 为什么适合这类用户： 租客可以把入住和退租证据整理在一起 房东可以集中管理交房、收房、水电燃气和资料记录 同一个人既能当租客使用，也能当房东使用 所有数据默认保存在本机 租约档案的目标是轻量、实用、清晰。它不是云协作平台，不提供在线收租，也不是财务记账工具。 欢迎提交功能建议或改进想法： 邮箱：842797413@qq.com 或在 App Store 评价中留下你的想法

6793896916.name: 白帆 - 实时网络质量检测
6793896916.trackName: 白帆 - 实时网络质量检测
6793896916.description: 在家不知道床边、沙发还是书桌更适合打游戏？在户外觉得移动网络不稳定？在咖啡馆、办公室或酒店准备开视频会议或语音通话？ 白帆（WhiteSail）帮你亲自检测并比较不同位置的实际网络体验，为游戏、视频和通话选择更合适的已测位置。 实时体验 当 App 位于前台且正在显示“实时”页时，白帆会持续更新反应、波动和中断数据，帮助你理解当前连接状态；它不进行 Mbps 带宽测速。 比较常用位置 在你实际使用网络的各个位置分别完成约 5 秒检测。已保存结果会按当前 WiFi 或移动网络过滤，方便比较亲自测过的位置。白帆不会扫描周边信号，也不会在你检测前自动推荐位置。 隐私说明 无需账号，无广告，无第三方追踪 SDK。位置权限仅用于让 iOS 返回当前 WiFi 名称；白帆不请求或保存地理坐标。网络检测会访问外部网络服务，其服务器可能依据自身政策处理 IP 地址等请求信息。 产品边界 白帆只测量反应、波动和中断，不测 Mbps 带宽，也不能增强网络覆盖。它只帮助你在亲自检测过的位置中选择相对更合适的地方。

6788214877.name: 疯狂摩托- FC复古版
6788214877.description: 抬腕，油门就拧上了。 俯视角窄道里，橙黑摩托带着琥珀光晕往前冲——车道比赛车更窄，车身更灵，反应慢半拍就是撞护栏。这不是划划屏幕的卡牌，是一弯一弯压出来的。 —— 手腕一倾，道就换了 —— Apple Watch 上倾斜压弯换道，三车道里找空隙超车；长按油门加速，点一下出发。不想倾斜？手机上滑动换道同样顺手，还能点喷气猛冲一把。 —— 窄道竞速：快，更要准 —— 对手摩托从两侧掠过，你得在更窄的路面里卡位、换道、贴弯。超车涨分，速度随分往上飙；一不留神蹭到路肩——摔车，重来。早一秒变道超过去，晚一秒就是追尾。 —— 六条公路，一种无尽 —— 海岸公路迎风，山间弯道连环，都市环线穿隧道，沙漠飞驰扬尘，森林小道蜿蜒，大桥冲刺贴栏。每条路对手数量不同，刷出自己的最快用时和名次。嫌不够？无尽公路一直跑，看你能冲多少分。 等地铁、等电梯那两分钟，抬腕拧一把。碎片时间过把瘾，右滑退回，全在腕上。

6756765173.name: Bifrost Relay
6756765173.description: Real-time video streaming with ultra-low latency. No cloud, no delay, no complexity. Relay turns your iPhone or iPad into a video streaming system for local networks. Stream video between Relay devices with ultra-low latency - perfect for practice mirrors, sports training, and real-time visual feedback. FEATURES Ultra-Low Latency Hardware-accelerated H.264 encoding delivers sub-100ms end-to-end latency on quality local networks. See yourself in real-time, not a second later. Local Network Only Everything stays on your WiFi network. No cloud services, no internet required, no monthly fees. Your video never leaves your local network. Dual Mode Interface Switch between Camera mode (stream your device's camera) and Monitor mode (receive video from other Relay devices). Simple, focused interface optimized for iPhone and iPad. Zero Configuration Automatic device discovery via Bonjour. No IP addresses to remember, no complex network setup. Just select a device and start streaming. Video-Only by Design No audio means no echo, no sync drift, and predictable performance. Perfect for scenarios where you just need to see yourself in real-time. Camera Flexibility Use any camera connected to your iPhone or iPad - built-in front or back cameras. Stream to any other device running Relay on your network. PERFECT FOR Dance studios and practice mirrors Sports training and form analysis Camera positioning and framing checks Presentation monitoring and confidence displays Video feedback for teaching and coaching Remote camera preview before recording Turn an iPad into a wireless monitor TECHNICAL DETAILS Hardware-accelerated H.264 encoding/decoding via VideoToolbox UDP/RTP streaming protocol (RFC 3984) Automatic device discovery via mDNS/Bonjour 1080p video at 30 fps Portrait and landscape orientation support Front and back camera support REQUIREMENTS iOS 17.0 or later / iPadOS 17.0 or later Strong WiFi connection (5GHz recommended for optimal performance) Camera permission for Camera mode Private WiFi network (not public/isolated networks) Relay app on both sending and receiving devices PRIVACY Relay doesn't collect, store, or transmit any data outside your local network. No analytics, no tracking, no cloud services, no servers. Everything is peer-to-peer on your local WiFi. SUPPORT Visit our website for documentation, FAQs, and support.

6748663168.description: Use this app to quickly and effortlessly calculate scores while solving the FIRST LEGO League Unearthed 2025-2026 robotic game challenges. (Regularly check official FLL challenge updates for the latest rules and clarifications. This app was developed independently of any organization.) 6761986229.name: Exposure Check
6761986229.description: Exposure Check brings professional-grade exposure analysis to your iPhone, iPad, and Mac for 1 low price! False color imaging — used by cinematographers on set worldwide — reveals exactly where your highlights clip and shadows crush before it's too late. Use this tool to import images from Movies, TV Shows, and more to reveal how professional cinematographers exposed their final graded images. SHOOT IN APPLE LOG Capture with the in-app camera in Apple Log and read exposure the way you would on a pro monitor. Zone and False Color overlays follow the exact Apple Log curve, so every zone lines up with true scene stops — the full dynamic range of your sensor, measured in real light. REAL-TIME FALSE COLOR CAMERA See your scene through a live false color overlay as you shoot. Instantly identify overexposed highlights, underexposed shadows, and perfectly exposed midtones — the same tools used on professional film sets, now in your pocket. TAP TO METER Tap anywhere in the frame for an instant zone readout and a recommended f-stop. Simulate any lens aperture with the IRIS control and get a recommendation to place your subject at 18% middle gray — before you roll. ZONE SYSTEM ANALYSIS Exposure Check maps your image into distinct one-stop tonal zones so you can evaluate exposure with precision and intent. MANUAL CAMERA CONTROLS Take full control with manual ISO, shutter angle, white balance, frame rate, and lens selection — plus pinch-to-zoom lens switching and a live, draggable histogram. ANALYZE ANY PHOTO Import photos from your library and run Zone or False Color analysis instantly. The stacked compare view shows your original and analyzed image together so you can see exactly what the exposure is doing. ORGANIZE WITH PROJECTS Create projects to keep your shots organized. Import directly from your photo library, move and copy images between projects, and review your work in a clean full-screen viewer with smooth swipe navigation. KEY FEATURES Live Apple Log capture with real-time Zone and False Color overlays Exact Apple Log curve — every zone is a true scene stop Tap to meter: zone readout + recommended f-stop anywhere in the frame Simulated IRIS with 18% gray recommendations Manual ISO, shutter angle, white balance, FPS, and lens controls Pinch-to-zoom lens switching and a live, draggable histogram Import and analyze photos from your library Stacked compare view — original above, analyzed below Adjustable color reference bar Project organization with multi-select, move, and copy Full-screen image viewer with smooth swipe navigation Share processed images directly from the app iPhone, iPad, and Mac supported A note on accuracy: On graded or imported images, overlays reflect the how the image was graded — not the exposure captured on set. For true scene-stop readings, shoot in Apple LOG with the built-in camera. Whether you're on set, shooting in the field, or reviewing work in post — Exposure Check gives you the exposure tools professionals rely on.

6461545946.name: EAT-26
6461545946.description: The Eating Attitudes Test (EAT-26) is probably the most widely used standardised measure of symptoms and concerns characteristic of eating disorders (Garner & Garfinkel, 1979; Garner, Olmsted, Bohr, & Garfinkel, 1982). The 26-item version (Garner et al., 1989) is highly reliable and valid. The EAT-26 alone does not yield a specific diagnosis of an eating disorder (neither the EAT-26, nor any other screening instrument, has been established as highly efficient as the sole means for identifying eating disorders). Nevertheless, many studies have used the EAT-26 as an economical first step in a two-stage screening process. The EAT-26 can be used in group or individual settings and is designed to be self- administered or be administered by health professionals, school counsellors, coaches, camp counsellors, and others with interest in gathering information to determine if an individual should be referred to a specialist for evaluation for an eating disorder. The version of the Eating Attitudes Test (EAT-26) has three criteria for determining if you should seek further evaluation of your risk of having an eating disorder. These are: 1) The total score on the actual EAT test items; 2) Behavioural questions indicating possible eating disorder symptoms or recent significant weight loss; 3) Low body weight compared to age-matched norms. The app does’t contain ads The app does’t collect personal data The app does’t contain additional payments ____ The app is not a medical instrument and is not a method for diagnosing a health condition. The EAT-26 is not designed to make a diagnosis of an eating disorder or to take the place of a professional diagnosis or consultation. The EAT-26 alone does not yield a specific diagnosis of an eating disorder. Neither the EAT-26, nor any other screening instrument, has been established as highly efficient as the sole means for identifying eating disorders. Body mass index (BMI) is a person’s weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in meters. BMI can be a screening tool, but it does not diagnose the body fatness or health of an individual.

The EAT-26 is not designed to make a diagnosis of an eating disorder or to take the place of a professional diagnosis or consultation. The EAT-26 alone does not yield a specific diagnosis of an eating disorder. Neither the EAT-26, nor any other screening instrument, has been established as highly efficient as the sole means for identifying eating disorders. Body mass index (BMI) is a person’s weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in meters. BMI can be a screening tool, but it does not diagnose the body fatness or health of an individual.

6478431169.name: 专注当下 - 每日时间管理工具
6478431169.trackName: 专注当下 - 每日时间管理工具
6478431169.description: 专注当下 — 不仅是一款时间价值管理工具，它还是引领我们进入高效专注状态的好伙伴。专为那些想要挑战的学生和不断攀登事业高峰的专业人士精心打造，无论你是正在准备日常重要考试、高考、考研、公务员考试，还是在积极学习新知识、新技能，专注当下都能成为你最可靠的助手，助你在自我实现的道路上保持清晰的方向、高效的执行，最终获得显著的成就。 真正能影响我们未来的不仅是详细的规划或高效的执行，更重要的是那些当下能够深刻影响未来的重要时刻。专注当下，就是那把开启时间价值之门的钥匙，它使我们能够最大限度地利用每一刻，让时间的流逝转化为成就的积累。 日常使用场景 重要考试备战：无论是期末大考还是人生转折点的高考、考研等，专注当下都能助你一臂之力。 业余爱好培养：无论是绘画、音乐还是其他兴趣，专注当下帮助你沉浸在创造的世界中。 家庭作业管理：让学习变得有条不紊，提高学习效率。 健康生活：跑步、健身，专注当下记录你的每一次努力。 旅行与活动：规划旅行，组织活动，专注当下让一切井井有条。 工作任务追踪：日常工作中的任务管理，让工作更加高效。 家庭生活：家务安排，照顾孩子，专注当下让家庭生活同样井然有序。 任何值得记录的时刻：生活中的每一刻精彩，都值得被专注当下所记录。 主要功能 今日待办追踪：清晰展示当日的任务清单。 无限待办事项：无论多少任务，都能轻松管理。 精美计时器：可视化计时，让专注时间一目了然。 Timeline支持：时间线视图，回顾你的成长轨迹。 翻转专注模式：创新的专注提醒方式，保持你的专注力。 每日总结与心情记录：反思与感悟，记录生活的点点滴滴。 详尽的时间报告：无论是日、周、月还是年，都能得到全面的时间使用报告。 专注的价值 效率的提升：全神贯注时，我们的工作效率和创造力达到顶峰，清晰思维带来更快的决策和更高的工作质量。 记忆的加深：专注的状态有助于巩固记忆，使学习和工作中的信息吸收更加深刻和持久。 创造力的激发：当我们沉浸在某个特定领域时，往往能够激发出前所未有的创意和灵感。 如何发挥专注当下的价值 规划先行：每日伊始，花些时间找出当日的重点任务，为一天设定清晰的目标和动力。 屏蔽干扰：在使用专注当下时，尽可能减少外界干扰，创造一个有利于集中注意力的环境。 合理安排休息：适时地休息，避免长时间专注导致的疲惫，利用短暂的休憩来恢复精力。 持续反思优化：每日结束时，回顾专注的效果，评估策略的有效性，并根据反馈进行调整，以确保专注当下成为促进个人进步的有效手段。 使用协议(标准苹果版)： https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6758758430.name: 凯格尔猫 - 盆底肌训练
6758758430.trackName: 凯格尔猫 - 盆底肌训练
6758758430.description: 凯格尔猫是一款可爱、轻量的凯格尔运动与盆底肌训练工具。它希望把这件私密又重要的小事，做得少一点压力、少一点医疗感，多一点温柔陪伴。 很多训练工具看起来严肃、冰冷，容易让人觉得自己像是在“治疗问题”。凯格尔猫选择了更轻松的方式：用猫咪视觉、柔和配色、清晰节奏和每日小目标，陪你在日常生活里慢慢建立练习习惯。 在凯格尔猫里，你可以跟随每日课程完成几分钟训练。App 会通过收缩、放松、呼吸等阶段提示，引导你一步步练习，不需要自己反复计时。训练过程简单、安静，也更适合在碎片时间完成。 主要功能： 猫咪陪练体验：用柔和可爱的界面陪你完成训练 每日训练计划：按阶段安排课程，适合循序渐进地练习 多种训练模式：包含常规、快速、耐力、阶梯等不同节奏 语音与声音提示：训练时不用一直盯着屏幕 训练记录：查看完成次数、训练时长和近期进度 练习提醒：设置适合自己的时间，减少遗忘 本地进度保存：训练数据保存在设备本地，无需注册账号 凯格尔猫不是严肃复杂的数据面板，也不想制造“生病感”。它更像一只安静陪伴的小猫，提醒你每天留出几分钟，关注盆底肌收缩、放松和呼吸的节奏。练习可以是轻松的，也可以是可持续的。 适合人群： 想开始凯格尔运动的新手 希望保持盆底肌日常练习习惯的用户 久坐、生活节奏忙，但想进行轻量训练的人 喜欢可爱猫咪风格、温柔提醒和清晰记录的用户 不喜欢严肃医疗风界面，希望训练体验更轻松的人 请注意：本 App 提供的是日常健康管理与运动辅助内容，不用于疾病诊断、治疗或替代专业医疗建议。如果你正在孕期、产后恢复期，或训练中出现疼痛、明显不适，建议先咨询医生或专业人士。 订阅与条款 连续包月为自动续期订阅，订阅周期为 1 个月。价格以购买页面显示的 App Store 本地化价格为准。订阅会自动续期，除非你在当前订阅周期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续期。你可以在 Apple ID 的订阅管理中取消或管理订阅。 Apple 标准许可协议（EULA）： https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 服务条款： https://my.feishu.cn/docx/VpI2dl9WgoGX7FxA2secxdAInyc?from=from_copylink 隐私政策： https://my.feishu.cn/docx/J80Wdf1XGo8OHOxp6RJctl54nJe?from=from_copylink

6787330792.name: Nestwell: Private & Productive
6787330792.description: Eight tools for a more productive life. One calm, private app. Nothing leaves your device. Your whole life doesn't belong scattered across a dozen apps, each one wanting your email, your data, and another monthly fee. Nestwell brings your planner, wallet, notes, diary, password vault, PDF reader, scanner, and reminders into a single beautifully calm home — every word, number, and secret stored locally on your device, with your vault locked behind a key only you hold. No accounts to create. No profiles to build. WHAT'S INSIDE Planner — Tasks, events and habits in one clear view. Build streaks and watch your consistency grow on a calm monthly calendar. Wallet — Track income, expenses, budgets and savings in any currency on earth, with a built-in calculator so the numbers always add up. Vault — Keep passwords, logins, secure notes and IDs behind a passphrase only you know. Zero-knowledge encryption means no one else can look inside. Notes — A real editor with rich text, tables, checklists, a freehand pen and file attachments — built for depth, not just quick capture. Diary — Write day by day in a warm, paper-style journal made for your eyes only, and keep your streak alive. Reader & Scanner — Open your PDFs in a built-in reader, and turn paper into clean digital documents in seconds. Reminders — Tie a reminder to a note, a diary entry, a vault item, or a plan. Eight tools that truly work as one. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Everything you create stays on your device — nothing is transmitted anywhere unless you choose to. When you choose to back up, every file is encrypted with a passphrase only you know before it ever leaves your phone, so even your backups are yours alone. Send them to iCloud or Google Drive, keep them on local storage, or stay completely device-only. Your vault goes even further — protected in a way that means no one, not even us, could ever look inside. That's Nestwell's promise. MAKE IT YOURS Three premium themes: Nestwell (dark), Paper (light), and Midnight (OLED black), paired with eight accent colors, from jewel tones to quiet neutrals. Available in 21 languages, so it feels like home in yours too. Beautiful on iPhone and iPad. Stop juggling apps. Stop handing over your data. Your private, productive life finally in one calm place. Download Nestwell and make it yours.

6791917990.description: 晚安不急（Unrush Sleep）是一款专注睡前白噪音与助眠声音的 App。没有订阅、没有广告、不需要账号——打开就能听，让夜晚慢慢安静下来。 为什么选择晚安不急 无订阅、无广告、无账号，体验干净 完全离线可用，收听记录只保存在本机 定时自动停止，设好时长安心睡着 播放、音量、定时集中在同一页，操作简单 隐私优先：不为推荐流、不为广告而收集听音内容 声音内容 精选稳态频谱与自然环境声，例如： 雨声、室内暖雨 海浪 风扇低频等稳态声 棕色噪音、粉红噪音、绿色噪音、柔和白噪音 更多适合睡前与放松的环境音 适合这些时刻 入睡困难、想更快安静下来 午休、小睡、熬夜后的缓冲 哄睡、婴儿睡前背景声（作环境声使用） 阅读、学习、需要专注时 想盖住房间杂音或轻微耳鸣感时（非医疗产品，不能替代治疗） 怎么用 1. 选择一个声景 2. 可选：打开自动停止并设定分钟数 3. 播放——支持锁屏 / 控制中心继续听（系统能力范围内） 关于音频与声明 部分声音为精心制作的环境音 / AI 辅助生成音频，便于离线稳定播放。本 App 不是医疗器械，不诊断、不治疗失眠或任何疾病。 支持与条款 官网：https://qxmstudio.com/unrush/ 隐私政策：https://qxmstudio.com/unrush/privacy-zh.html 使用条款：https://qxmstudio.com/unrush/terms-zh.html 晚安不急 —— 不急着睡，先安静下来。

6794661636.name: 电波表对时助手
6794661636.description: 专为电波手表爱好者打造的对时神器 你的电波表是否经常对时不成功?住在信号覆盖边缘地区,或者住在地下室、高层建筑里,难以接收到电波信号?电波对时表助手帮你解决这个问题。 核心功能: 全球电波协议支持 支持六大全球电波授时协议,包括中国BPC、日本JJY40/JJY60、美国WWVB、英国MSF、德国DCF77。无论你的手表来自哪个国家,都能找到匹配的协议。 一键对时操作 选择对应协议,点击开始发送,将手机靠近手表即可完成对时。清晰的波形显示让你实时了解发送状态,音量检测功能帮你调整到理想位置。 轮播自动切换 支持多协议轮播模式,自动切换不同电波协议,适合拥有多款不同品牌手表的用户。 实用时间工具 内置世界时钟,随时查看全球时区;秒表和倒计时器,满足日常计时需求;对时历史记录,回溯每次同步详情。 使用提示: 确保手机音量调至合适位置 将手表靠近手机扬声器 建议在安静环境中操作 每次对时建议持续2-3分钟 适用于各种电波表 让你的电波表时刻保持精准,从此告别手动校时。

6670143456.name: Aviation Mechanic O&P
6670143456.description: The Oral and Practical (O&P) exams are the last steps for the certification of an aviation mechanic. You will work one-on-one with a designated mechanic evaluator (DME) who will determine if you possess the knowledge, risk management, and skill level needed to be issued an FAA Aviation Mechanic Certificate. This Aviation Mechanic Oral & Practical app will help you prepare for this significant step towards your new career. The app is designed to prepare aviation mechanic applicants to demonstrate their skill and understanding of the required elements outlined in the FAA airman certification standards (FAA-S-ACS-1). This resource includes information on the certification process and covers all the practical skills and required knowledge in a question-and-answer format, with references defined for further study. Using a question-and-answer format, Oral & Practical lists the questions most likely to be asked by examiners during the last step in the Aviation Mechanic certification process – the Practical Exam – and provides succinct, ready responses. Aviation Mechanics will find this App an indispensable tool in both planning for what to expect during the O&P, and mastering the subject matter. Instructors rate them as excellent preparation for students, as well as general refresher material. This Aviation Mechanic Oral & Practical app is based on the popular Aviation Mechanic Oral & Practical Exam Guide, by Keith Anderson. It is designed for applicants training for an Aviation Mechanic certificate with Airframe and Powerplant ratings. Questions and responses ensure the subjects an aviation mechanic candidate will be tested on during the O&P are covered. Questions can be marked for further study from any subject to build your own collection of flashcards. Compatible with iOS phones and tablets, this app teaches applicants not only what to expect, but also how to exhibit subject mastery and confidence when under the examiner’s scrutiny. It identifies candidates’ strengths, weaknesses, and gaps in their aeronautical knowledge, which increases study efficiency. App features: Knowledge, risk management and skill questions and projects are supported with ACS codes, FAA references and succinct, ready responses. Questions from any subject can be flagged for further study into a separate group. Includes the questions and answers from the popular book, Aviation Mechanic Oral & Practical Exam Guide 5th Edition, by Keith Anderson. Brought to you by a trusted resource in aviation training and publishing, Aviation Supplies & Academics (ASA).

6793005819.name: 咏春拳入门-功夫入门心法手法一站学
6793005819.trackName: 咏春拳入门-功夫入门心法手法一站学
6793005819.description: 《咏春拳入门》面向零基础与初学者，带你系统认识咏春的根基与节奏。应用以「中线、结构、精简」为主线，把站姿、小念头与常用手法拆成清晰步骤，配合图文要点与易错提醒，帮助你把动作练对、练稳。 打开即可开始习练：二字拑羊马打牢根基，小念头按段跟练，摊手、膀手、伏手、冲拳等手法可单独巩固。跟练支持站桩计时、分段引导与整套串联，也可选择慢练、标准或快练节奏，边练边听语音口诀，沉肩坠肘、守住中线。 心法模块用短文讲清中线理论、结构优先、攻守同在等入门观念，并配有巩固测验与速查口诀，方便练前扫一眼、练后自查。今日页会根据时段推荐合适方案，记录连续打卡、累计时长与成就进度，让坚持看得见。 你还可以收藏常用功法、写下练习笔记，导出或导入个人进度，按自己的字号与偏好调整体验。内容强调安全与循序渐进，适合居家自学打基础；若继续深入黐手、寻桥等，建议再寻明师面授。 从站稳马步，到走完小念头，从听懂心法，到养成每日一练——《咏春拳入门》陪你把咏春的第一步走扎实。

6758040454.name: 家地小记
6758040454.description: 常年在外奔波，老家的田地边界、宅基地位置，是不是慢慢记不清了？ 「家地小记」是专为你打造的个人老家土地私藏工具—— 不用复杂流程，随手就能把自家每一块土地的位置、面积、备注都存进手机，把 “老家的根” 稳稳留在身边。 你可以这样用： 「随手记」：拍张土地照片、标个定位，一键存下土地信息； 「随时查」：不管在哪个城市，打开就能看到自家土地的详情； 「放心存」：纯个人私藏记录，仅用于自身信息留存，无任何法律证明效力。 把老家的每一寸土地，都变成手机里的专属记忆，再也不怕忘了 “老家的根”。 所有数据通过加密，不会丢失！

6749559246.name: 一桌好戏
6749559246.description: 聚会冷场，不知道玩什么？打开“一桌好戏”，从破冰互动到经典小游戏，一桌人马上进入状态。 【聚会互动】 真心话大冒险、我有你没有、谁是卧底、国王游戏、手势炸弹等多种互动玩法，适合朋友聚会、情侣约会和家庭娱乐。 【画画与猜词】 自由画板随手创作；你画我猜支持多人轮流作画和实时猜词，让每一轮都有新的笑点。 【骰子与纸牌】 骰子游乐场提供多种规则；纸牌游乐场集合派对与经典玩法，随时开桌，不再为道具和规则发愁。 【经典小游戏】 五子棋、拼图、贪吃蛇、2048、数独、记忆翻牌、反应力测试、推箱子、吃豆人和节奏玩法，既能多人同乐，也能一个人轻松挑战。 【成长与个性】 记录游戏成绩，解锁成就和主题，查看排行榜与个人主页，打造属于自己的聚会风格。 【多人连接】 部分玩法支持局域网或在线房间。面对面聚会可使用附近连接，远程好友也能通过房间一起参与。 温馨提示： 聚会任务应以自愿、安全和尊重为前提，任何参与者都可以随时拒绝不适合自己的题目或挑战。

6790315539.name: 动物叫声大全 - 带领孩子认识动物世界
6790315539.trackName: 动物叫声大全 - 带领孩子认识动物世界
6790315539.description: 动物叫声集合是一款极简、轻量、打开即用的动物音效工具。 这里收录了上百种常见动物叫声，覆盖野生动物、家养动物、鸟类、昆虫、鱼类等分类。每个动物都搭配真实图片和代表性叫声，孩子可以边看边听，快速建立对动物名称、形象和声音的认知。 主要功能： 上百种高清 MP3 动物叫声，点击图片即可播放 全部、野生动物、家养动物、鸟类、昆虫、鱼类分类浏览 支持动物名称搜索，快速找到想听的叫声 支持收藏常用动物，反复播放更方便 切换新动物时自动停止上一个音效 本地离线运行，无需联网也能使用 无广告、无会员、无推送，不收集用户数据 适用场景： 幼儿早教动物认知 家长陪伴孩子认识动物 课堂互动和趣味教学 日常娱乐、模仿动物声音 老人与儿童都能轻松使用的音效工具 我们希望它保持简单、安静、可靠：没有复杂菜单，没有多余干扰，打开 App，点击动物图片，就能听见动物叫声。

6670373201.name: FirstChair
6670373201.description: Are you a band, orchestra, or choir director looking for an easier way to plan and organize your seating arrangements? First Chair is designed specifically for you! Whether you're leading a small ensemble or a full orchestra, this app helps you create, customize, and manage seating charts for your musical groups with ease. Key Features: Customizable Seating Charts: Easily arrange your students in any configuration that suits your ensemble’s needs. Create layouts for bands, orchestras, and choirs. Virtual Stages: Set up multiple seating arrangements and save them for future use, making it easy to prepare for concerts, rehearsals, and classroom setups Flexible Layouts: Support for both grid-based and arc-based seating designs to accommodate different performance settings Chairs and Stands: Get over all numbers and per row chairs and stands Names: Add names to your seating charts Export: Save or print images of your seating charts

6781581356.name: EpubCraft: EPUB Editor & OCR
6781581356.description: EpubCraft is a complete ebook studio for iPad and Mac. Create EPUBs from scratch, polish imported books, or turn a scanned PDF into a clean, reflowable ebook — with no account, no subscription, no ads, and no tracking. Your books are saved locally on your device, and OCR runs entirely on-device using Apple Vision. A real editor, two ways to work Switch instantly between a visual editor and a raw-HTML source view, with live preview in edit, preview, or split layout. Everything you type round-trips losslessly, so power users get full control while everyone else just writes. Bring in anything Import EPUB, DOCX (Word), Markdown, plain text, and ZIP files. Merge several EPUBs into a single book with drag-to-reorder and automatic asset de-duplication — perfect for combining chapters, volumes, or serialized releases. Scan paper into ebooks (OCR Studio) Point EpubCraft at a scanned PDF and let on-device Apple Vision OCR do the rest. It filters running headers and footers, groups text back into proper paragraphs, detects chapter breaks, and stitches pages together — including smart handling for languages without spaces, like Thai. Turn an out-of-print scan into a tidy, searchable EPUB. Export everywhere readers are Standard EPUB for Apple Books and most readers KFX for Amazon Kindle KEPUB for Kobo Raw ZIP for inspection and debugging Format conversion (KFX, KEPUB) runs on-device. Make it look right Apply chapter templates, global CSS, and footnote styles. Embed custom fonts so your book looks identical on every device. Built-in templates include polished defaults plus first-class Thai typography. Powerful clean-up tools Book-wide search and replace, plus a library of saved regular-expression presets for the messy realities of imported text: split chapters on headings (English, Thai, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and more), strip Word artifacts, collapse blank lines, normalize quotes and scene breaks, and remove page numbers from OCR output — all in a couple of taps. No account, no ads, no tracking EpubCraft has no sign-in and no advertising or analytics SDKs. Your books are saved locally on your device. A few features connect to online services to do their job — optional Thai word-spacing — so see our Privacy Policy for exactly what each one sends. Whether you're self-publishing a novel, archiving a scanned book, converting a manuscript for Kindle or Kobo, or just fixing a broken EPUB, EpubCraft gives you professional control without the complexity.

6786577313.name: DaybreakIn: Intentions Journal
6786577313.description: Live with intention, not pressure. DaybreakIn is a calm daily planner, focus timer, and reflective journal for choosing what matters, shaping a realistic schedule, and remembering how your day actually felt. It brings planning, focus, pauses, and stories together without asking you to optimize every hour. BEGIN WITH ONE INTENTION Choose a meaningful intention each morning. It becomes a quiet point of return when plans change, distractions appear, or the day feels heavier than expected. Keep it visible above your timeline and edit it whenever your priorities shift. DESCRIBE YOUR DAY NATURALLY Write or speak about what is on your mind. DaybreakIn can organize your words into a reviewable draft of Task Focus sessions and reminders, including suggested times when available. Check the results before adding anything to your timeline, so you remain in control. PLAN WITH A VISUAL TIMELINE See your day in one clear timeline instead of an overwhelming list. Schedule focused work, adjust times and durations, mark items complete, and understand what comes next. Dynamic spacing keeps busy periods compact while making longer gaps easy to understand. FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS Every task can become a timed Task Focus session. Start a focus timer directly from the timeline and follow its progress without creating a separate task type. Focus Shield can optionally use Apple's Screen Time frameworks to restrict apps and categories you choose while a Task Focus timer runs. Focus Shield is free. DaybreakIn does not read, display, upload, or retain your Screen Time usage history. BRING YOUR CALENDAR TOGETHER Optionally show Apple Calendar events and Reminders inside your DaybreakIn timeline. Choose which sources appear and turn synchronization on or off whenever you want. PAUSE WHEN YOU NEED TO Take a guided breath, name how you feel, and decide whether you want to say more. Write or speak a few words about what is happening; a few words are enough. Saved Pause moments become part of today's record and story. TURN EACH DAY INTO A STORY DaybreakIn brings together your intention, timeline, completed activities, Pause moments, and feeling check-in to create a personal daily story. Revisit saved days in Stories and choose what you want to preserve or share. On compatible devices, create a private on-device illustration with Apple's Image Playground. A mood-based fallback remains available when a generated image is not. DaybreakIn Pro unlocks advanced insights and turns selected days into polished storybook PDFs designed to keep or share. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Your entries can sync through your private iCloud account. Core planning and reflection features remain available offline. Choose which permissions and capabilities suit you from Settings. DAYBREAKIN CAN HELP YOU: Set and revisit a meaningful daily intention Turn natural language into a reviewable plan Organize Task Focus sessions and reminders Follow the day through a visual timeline Start timers directly from focused tasks Reduce distractions with optional Focus Shield Show Apple Calendar events and Reminders Pause and reflect through writing or speech Record moods and meaningful moments Preserve each day as a personal story Export storybook PDFs with DaybreakIn Pro Explore longer patterns with advanced insights Use widgets, Live Activities, and Apple Watch FOR REAL, IMPERFECT DAYS You do not need to finish everything or feel the same every day. Begin with one intention, take the next meaningful step, pause when needed, and preserve the parts of your day worth remembering. DaybreakIn includes optional auto-renewable Monthly and Annual subscriptions and a one-time Lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Privacy Policy: https://tryonetoday.calicocatstudio.workers.dev/privacy#daybreakin Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6760287864.name: TimeCatcher
6760287864.description: TimeCatcher 旨在让你轻松开始时间追踪，并持续坚持。它不会把记录时间变成一件麻烦事，而是用轻量的方式帮你捕捉自己正在做的事，并回顾时间都花在了哪里。 目标很简单：帮助你建立对时间的觉察。当你能清楚看见时间的去向，就更容易提升专注力、发现规律，并做出更好的决定。

6747669662.name: TicketMe
6747669662.description: 曾经订了电影票，却因为被上百封未读邮件淹没而找不到票根？ 别再为此烦恼了！现在，您可以保存电影票，还能将电影票存入 Apple Wallet，并在影院上映时自动弹出！ 这款简洁易用的应用，让您轻松创建电影票。添加到 Apple Wallet 后，您还可以直接从应用中删除电影票！ 复制您最常用的电影票，只需填写时间、姓名和票号即可！ ▶ 功能！ 智能位置提醒 - 当您到达场馆时，您的门票会自动显示在锁屏上 基于时间的通知 - 在恰当的时间提醒您即将参加的活动 通用票务支持 - 电影票、机票、音乐会、博物馆门票以及任何其他活动 键钱包集成 - 立即将任何门票转换为专业的 Apple Wallet 通行证 复制和自定义 - 复制常用场馆的门票，只需更新详细信息，即可节省时间 简洁的界面 - 没有杂乱的元素，只有井然有序的门票 ▶ 商店通行证 您现在还可以添加带有自定义颜色和图像的商店通行证 您还可以将商店通行证分配到各自的组，以便在 Apple Wallet 中将它们分组管理

6771803006.trackName: 金属探测仪 · 找钥匙

6767601608.name: 多任务计时助手
6767601608.description: 多任务计时助手是一款简洁高效的移动端计时应用，专注于同时管理多个倒计时和秒表任务。无论是健身训练、烹饪美食、学习专注，还是工作计时，它都能帮你轻松应对多任务时间管理的需求。 核心功能： 多计时器并行运行：同时创建和运行多个独立的倒计时和秒表，互不干扰 场景化预设时长：提供健身、烹饪、学习、工作等场景的常用时长预设（15分钟、25分钟、30分钟、1小时等） 自定义时长：支持自由设置任意时长，精确到秒 定时提醒：计时完成时通过通知和振动提醒你，支持多种提醒铃声选择 后台运行：计时器支持后台运行，切换到其他应用也不会中断 适用场景： 健身：间歇训练、HIIT计时、运动时长控制 烹饪：多道菜同时烹饪的时间管理 学习：番茄工作法、专注时长控制、考试计时 工作：会议计时、任务时限管理 产品特点： 完全离线使用，无需网络连接 无广告，简洁纯净的用户体验 不收集任何用户数据，保护隐私安全 界面设计简洁直观，操作流畅 支持多计时器同时运行，实时查看所有任务进度

6450692269.name: 康熙大字典
6450692269.description: 《康熙字典》是学习传统文化不可或缺的工具。本APP内置了最全本的《康熙字典》，并按传统方式实现了字头检索汉字。同时基于现代人的习惯，还实现了搜索、拼音检索、注音检索、部首检索、笔画检索。最重要的，我们还为它添加了汉字识别功能，这就意味着我们可以对实物上的汉字，通过本APP进行查看释义。 《康熙字典》是一部成书于清朝康熙五十五年（1716年）的汉字字典，记录了当时汉语中汉字的点画写法、音读和义训。《康熙字典》共载47,043字。按地支分为十二集，每集再分为上、中、下3卷，构成正文共36卷。同时以214个部首分类，一一列出《广韵》、《集韵》、《韵会》、《唐韵》等韵书的音切，并注有“反切”、“直音”两种注音。出处、及参考等，多引《尚书》、《孟子》、《庄子》、《荀子》、《史记》、《左传》等经、史、子、集之书为证。

6789106078.name: DelayScaper
6789106078.description: DelayScaper is an AUv3 effects plugin that can run standalone, or in any AUv3 compatible host such as Logic Pro, GarageBand or AUM. DelayScaper currently runs on iOS (iPad & iPhone) and macOS (Intel & Silicon) and is available as a Universal Purchase from the Apple App Store. Overview DelayScaper is a dual dynamic delay effect designed to produce inspiring, and sometimes very unpredictable results that literally responds dynamically to audio input. Playing an instrument through DelayScaper can be especially rewarding when you adjust your playing to what you’re hearing, because DelayScaper can be configured to constantly modify its parameters according to the intensity and spacing of your notes. It’s like having five extra pairs of hands twiddling knobs for you! At its core, DelayScaper comprises two identical stereo delay modules that can run in series or parallel. While it can cover “normal” delay duties, including host tempo syncable delay times, DelayScaper is really for those who like to experiment with sound, especially in the atmospheric and ambient realm. With a maximum delay time of 8 seconds, you can even use DelayScaper as an old-school “free looper” for “Frippertronics” type evolving soundscapes. DelayScaper also features two bonus “one knob FX” effects that are both original designs that complement the core delay processing: “Octave Grains” is a randomised and delayed pitch-shifting algorithm that sits somewhere between a pitch-shifted delay and granular shimmer effect. “Random Reverse” does what you might expect it to do, but often in an unexpected way! Both algorithms will grab random sections of the incoming audio, process it, then feed those into the main delay processing. The dynamics section is where DelayScaper comes to life, and includes dedicated envelope followers for both delays, which can then be used as a modulation source for up to 5 delay parameters for each delay. For example, you can modulate the mix level to create a “ducking delay”, or modulate tone so the delay repeats get brighter or darker depending on how hard or softly you play. A “cascade” feature sends the output of the first delay into the second, allowing you to fine-tune the balance between parallel and series mode.

6760637402.name: DidYouPoop : 拉了吗、排便记录、便便记录
6760637402.trackName: DidYouPoop : 拉了吗、排便记录、便便记录
6760637402.description: DidYouPoop 是一款偏温和、重隐私的排便记录工具，帮助你用更低负担的方式记录每天状态，并在回看时更快看懂近期变化。 很多人并不是真的不想记录，而是大多数健康记录工具要么太重，要么太冷。DidYouPoop 希望把这件事做得更简单一些：打开就能记，几秒就能存，之后也能在需要时快速回顾最近有没有异常变化。 V2.0 重点补强了“记录后怎么看”这件事。你可以更快完成首页打卡，也可以在日志页直接使用快捷筛选查看最近状态；如果近期有值得注意的异常信号，应用会用更克制、更容易理解的方式帮你整理出来，而不是给你制造压力。 应用支持记录时间、布里斯托分型、颜色、疼痛、费力感、紧迫感、血丝、黏液、备注以及“今天没排”状态，并将这些信息组织成更容易回看的趋势与摘要。你不需要维护复杂档案，也不需要学习很多术语，就能更自然地保留自己的日常变化。 DidYouPoop 也重视隐私边界。所有记录默认保存在设备本地，无账号、无广告、无云端上传。你还可以按需开启手势锁，让这类比较私密的健康记录多一层本地保护。 如果你想要的是一个不夸张、不说教、但足够好用的排便记录助手，DidYouPoop 会更接近这种感觉：先帮你轻松记下来，再在你愿意看的时候，用更温和的方式帮你理解它。 欢迎提交功能建议或改进想法： 邮箱：842797413@qq.com 或在 App Store 评价中留下想法

6790808769.name: 食刻记
6790808769.description: 把记录饮食，简单到只需要开口。 抬起 Apple Watch，说出你吃了什么。 AI 会根据你的描述识别食物，并估算热量，让每一次饮食记录都更加轻松。 无论是早餐、午餐、晚餐，还是零食、饮料，都可以随时记录，让管理每日热量变得更加简单自然。 功能特色： 1.语音记录 直接在 Apple Watch 上说出饮食内容，无需手动搜索食物或输入信息。 记录过程更加轻松，让你专注于生活，而不是记录本身。 2.AI 热量估算 根据语音描述智能识别食物，并估算热量。 快速了解每次饮食的大致热量摄入，为日常饮食管理提供参考。 3.每日热量统计 手机端自动汇总每日饮食记录。 通过清晰的数据展示，了解当天热量摄入情况，帮助你保持饮食习惯。 4.热量日历 按天、按月查看历史记录。 持续记录每一次饮食，回顾自己的变化，让坚持变得更加简单。 5.专为 Apple Watch 打造 抬腕即可记录饮食。 无需频繁拿出手机，让记录自然融入日常生活。 适合的人群： 希望管理每日热量摄入 正在减脂、增肌或控制体重 想培养持续记录饮食的习惯 喜欢使用 Apple Watch 管理健康生活 温馨提示： 应用提供的热量数据由 AI 根据用户描述进行估算，仅供日常饮食记录和管理参考，不作为医疗、营养或专业健康建议。

6789341656.name: BassEducation Composer
6789341656.description: See where the harmony can go — and why. BE Composer is a writing tool for musicians and student who want to understand the choices they're making. Put down a chord and it shows you where that chord actually wants to go, ranked by how often the move gets used — with the reasoning in plain English underneath. You're not guessing. You're learning the language while you write. Tap a suggestion to hear it before you commit. Hold it to lock it in. Keep going, and the tune builds itself in front of you. SEE IT AND HEAR IT Every chord shows its voicing on a piano keyboard, note for note — exactly what you're hearing, not an approximation. A guitar shape sits alongside as a visual reference. A real sampled piano plays the chords and a real electric bass takes the roots underneath, so a progression sounds like music instead of a computer. READ IT LIKE A CHART Flip to the lead sheet and the whole tune becomes a chord chart you can read at arm's length — the kind you'd put on a music stand. Type new chords straight into it, mark your sections like rehearsal letters, and watch a playback line sweep the bars as it plays. Export it as a PDF chart, or send a song as a link that opens straight into the app on someone else's phone. SHAPE THE SOUND Set the spice from Pop to Bebop and every suggestion and voicing rethinks itself. Slip passing chords in between what you've already written. Change any chord's bass note for an inversion or a slash chord. Set how long each chord holds. Play the whole thing back at any tempo, with a click if you want one — or start from any chord in the middle. Your songs save to a library you can organize into playlists, like sets. Built by a touring bassist, for anyone who writes music — on any instrument.

6779779811.name: BassEducation Ear Trainer
6779779811.description: Great ears aren't a gift — they're a habit. BE Ear Trainer builds yours a few minutes at a time. Open the app, hit Play, and start naming what you hear. No setup, no theory lecture — just sound, your answer, and instant feedback. Four ways to train: name the distance between two notes (Intervals), the color of a chord — major, minor, sevenths (Chord Quality), the mood of a scale, like Dorian or Mixolydian (Modal Color), or where a note sits in the key (Scale Degrees, with numbers or solfège). Questions play on a warm, real sampled piano — clear, musical reference tones, not synth beeps. And when you just want to explore, switch to Free Play: a no-quiz reference mode. Pick Intervals or Chords, tap any one to hear it from any root, and read a quick theory card — the actual notes, the spelling, and where it turns up in real music. It's the perfect warm-up before you test, or a fast way to check a sound. Difficulty grows with you: start with a handful of answers and unlock more as you level up. A built-in coach gives hands-on tips for every mode, and two printable cheat-sheets — a practice field guide and a theory reference (modes, chords, and how they're built) — are yours to save or share as a PDF. Your streaks and stats stick around, so you can watch the habit pay off. Built by a touring bassist and educator who uses this exact practice to keep his ears on the bandstand.

6779779359.description: The metronome that gigs with you. Built by touring bassist Damian Erskine, BE Metronome wraps a big, gorgeous tempo wheel around the controls working musicians actually use — then adds Pro Modes that turn it into a full stage tool. A serious metronome on its own: Big tempo wheel — drag to spin, nudge ±1/±5, or half/double time Odd & compound meters (5/4, 7/8, 9/8) alongside the standards Tap any beat to set accents — hard, light, or off Subdivision mixer — downbeat, 8ths, 16ths, triplets Real click voices: wood block, shaker, pandeiro, a full drum kit, beep, or a spoken count Practice Coach — tempo ramps that speed you up (or down) over bars, plus quiet-count drills that drop random bars to test your inner clock Swing, tap tempo, count-in, and a stay-awake practice screen Pro Modes — one-time unlock, no subscription: Library — save any groove (tempo, meter, accents, sound, mix) as a named song and pull it back anytime Set Lists — build ordered sets for every gig; reorder and rearrange in seconds Live Mode — run a whole set on a clean stage screen: huge start/stop, hands-free advance, tap any song to jump, count-in, a screen flash for loud rooms, and per-song auto-stop No accounts, no clutter — just the one tool you reach for every day, done right.

6759634274.name: AR昆虫採集 ミクロモンスターズ
6759634274.trackName: AR昆虫採集 ミクロモンスターズ
6759634274.description: キミのまわりが昆虫採集フィールドに変わる。 最新AR技術で再現された、リアルな昆虫採集体験。本アプリは、虫さがしと図鑑づくりが楽しめる昆虫採集型エンターテイメントアプリです。スマホのカメラをかざすと、ふしぎでかっこいい“怪虫（ミクロモンスター）”たちが目の前に出現。写真を撮って捕獲し、キミだけの昆虫図鑑を完成させよう！ 遊び方はシンプル。世界各国から集められた個性豊かな昆虫の中から、捕まえたい虫を選択。ヒントを頼りに「いそうな場所」や「出現しそうな時間」を想像しながらカメラを向けると…？　キミの撮った写真が図鑑に早変わり！ 夏休みの自由研究にもピッタリです。 すべての虫の写真を撮影し、図鑑をコンプリート。ミクモンマスターをめざそう！ 外でも家でも、どこでも楽しめる新感覚AR昆虫採集。お出かけ先や自然観察の時間が、そのまま冒険のフィールドに変わります。 【安心して遊べる設計】 ・アプリ内課金、広告表示はありません。※個人情報の収集もありません ・夜遅い時間帯は虫の出現が制限される安心設計。 ・昼間のプレイに限定することで、苦手な虫との遭遇を避けることも可能です。 ・外出先だけでなく、ご自宅でも安全に楽しめます。 【保護者の方へ】 虫が苦手な大人でも、お子さまと一緒に安心して楽しめる設計です。リアルに表現された昆虫の動きや特徴を通して、遊びながら自然や生態への興味を育むことができます。昆虫に夢中なお子さまから、かつて昆虫採集を楽しんだお父さん世代まで、ご家族でお楽しみいただけます。 【前作『世界の昆虫採集』を遊んでくれた方へ】 あれから約10年。最新AR技術で生まれ変わった、新時代のデジタル昆虫採集ができました！大人になった少年（ヒーロー）たちよ、集結せよ！

6786705222.name: BaroCast
6786705222.description: BaroCast 是一款专为 Apple Watch 设计的气压趋势工具。 它会记录手表气压计采集的气压数据，以清晰图表展示最近 12 小时的变化。你可以查看当前气压和最近 3 小时气压升降幅度，并设置下降阈值达到后触发暴风雨预警。 支持后台刷新，以及当前气压和 3 小时变化幅度表盘小组件。后台采集时间由 watchOS 调度，建议开启“后台 App 刷新”并将小组件添加到表盘。 气压会受到海拔、电梯、上下楼和移动路线影响。趋势与预警仅供参考，不能替代官方天气预报或灾害预警。

6794281589.name: Dear Passengers Panic Playbook
6794281589.description: Prepare for turbulence with Passenger Panic Playbook Learn what is currently known about the game, prepare your crew, practice emergency responses, and test your knowledge before your first chaotic flight. Your pre-flight companion Explore an easy-to-read briefing covering the game’s confirmed features, including online co-op, cabin responsibilities, risky cargo, dynamic weather, and physics-based chaos. Build the perfect crew Discover practical strategies for different crew responsibilities: Pilot Cabin Lead Fixer Runner Learn how to divide tasks, communicate clearly, secure the cabin, and stop small problems from becoming complete disasters. Practice emergency procedures Use interactive checklists to prepare for: Severe turbulence Cabin fires Loose cargo Multiple emergencies happening at once Complete every action and stabilize the cabin before the situation gets out of control. Test your knowledge Take the interactive crew quiz, receive explanations for every answer, and find out whether you are ready to fly—or need another training session.

6761789354.name: Aircraft Maintenance Assistant
6761789354.description: Unlock Instant Access to Aircraft Maintenance References, Troubleshooting, and System Resets Aircraft Maintenance Assistant (AMA) is a premium, professional-grade technical reference suite designed specifically for aircraft maintenance technicians, licensed engineers, and aviation students. Streamline your line and hangar operations by navigating complex manual structures, troubleshooting paths, and circuit breaker layouts with unprecedented speed. Comprehensive Fleet Support Access organized, fleet-specific maintenance references for the world’s most widely used commercial aircraft: Airbus A321 (LEAP-1A, CFM56, V2500) Airbus A330 (PW4000) Boeing 737 MAX (LEAP-1B) Boeing 777 (GE90, Trent 800) Key Features & Technical Tools: AMM Summaries & References: Browse chapter-by-chapter maintenance hierarchies (Chapters, Sections, Page Blocks) and view specific task summaries instantly. Interactive Connected Navigation: All summaries are fully connected. Tap on Directed Tasks, Circuit Breakers (CB), or Access Panels directly inside a procedure to jump straight to their respective drawings, layouts, and coordinates. Tools & Consumable Materials: Instantly view required tools, equipment, part numbers, and references for each task with the built-in materials inspector. TSM & FIM Reference Finder: Instantly search troubleshooting tasks by reference number, description, or maintenance messages. Access symptom lists and possible faults to identify the correct maintenance path quickly. Circuit Breaker (CB) Finder: Easily locate CBs by name or panel number. View exact panel coordinates (Row/Column) and reference high-contrast, zoomable panel diagrams. Access Panel Finder: Locate panels by number, zone, or station index. Access detailed panel placement diagrams directly on your device. ECAM Reset Procedures (A321 & A330): Navigate system computer resets, Built-In Test Equipment (BITE) tests, and safety procedures. Features a direct MMEL / MEL Info integration for operational dispatch criteria. 100% Offline Architecture: Entire reference suite is stored locally. No internet connection is required in the hangar,or on the line. Premium Dark UI: Designed for high-contrast visibility under harsh hangar lighting or night shifts to minimize eye strain. Designed for the Line & Hangar AMA provides a lightning-fast, modern roadmap to your daily maintenance tasks. Disclaimer: This application is intended for training and reference purposes only. It does not replace, supersede, or augment official aircraft manuals, airline standard operating procedures, or operator policies. Always refer to current and effective manufacturer documentation (AMM/FIM/MEL) for operational maintenance tasks.

6795366716.name: WorkList-工作记录与月度清单，随手记工作，成果不遗漏
6795366716.trackName: WorkList-工作记录与月度清单，随手记工作，成果不遗漏
6795366716.description: WorkList 是一款用于记录工作过程、整理成果文件、按月导出清单的本地化工作管理工具。 你可以为不同客户、项目或工作方向建立项目组，并在项目组内按月份记录每天完成的工作。每条工作记录可填写名称、时间、分类、工作周期、内容说明，并可关联成果文件或图片。 WorkList 支持从微信、文件 App 等位置导入资料，将文件保存到 App 本地，方便后续查看、归档和再次分享。月底统计时，可按月份、时间顺序或分类汇总导出工作清单，也可以导出日报和成果文件压缩包。 主要功能： 按项目组管理不同工作内容 按月份记录工作事项 支持自定义工作分类 支持附件、图片和成果文件归档 支持从微信转存文件到 App 支持导出工作清单和日报 支持导出成果文件压缩包 支持本地备份与导入恢复 所有数据保存在本机，不依赖云端 WorkList 适合咨询、设计、策划、运营、工程服务、项目管理、自由职业者及需要定期整理工作成果的人使用。 随手记成果，月底少遗漏。

6789408515.name: Focus-专注力自控力认知训练
6789408515.trackName: Focus-专注力自控力认知训练
6789408515.description: Focus 把认知心理学与神经科学中的经典范式，做成你每天都能完成的 3–15 分钟微训练。 你是不是也有过这些时刻？ 眼睛在看屏幕，脑子已经飘走 明明知道不该刷手机，手还是点了下去 下午犯困，读两行字就走神 想坚持专注，却不知道练什么、有没有进步 Focus 不承诺「治愈」或「诊断」，它是一套可重复的脑力健身计划——像练肌肉一样练你的注意网络。 【15 项科学认知练习】 按四大能力分类，一键开练： 持续注意 — 专注锁定、舒尔特方格、D2 注意力测试、警觉控制 冲动抑制 — 抑制测试、斯特鲁普冲突、侧向抑制、维度切换 工作记忆 — 双 N-Back、空间跨度、空间逆向、视觉成对联想、节奏点击、时间知觉 神经恢复 — 谐振呼吸、箱式呼吸等恢复练习 【看得见的成长】 每日目标与连续打卡，养成稳定训练节奏 认知勋章成就墙，点亮 30 枚成长里程碑 成长分析：准确率、反应时、训练趋势一目了然 时段洞察：清晨 / 正午 / 黄昏 / 夜间训练建议 【脑科学知识库】 不是空练——每项练习都关联科学说明，帮你理解「为什么练这个」： 前额叶调控、多巴胺网络、突触可塑性、ADHD 相关认知特征等。 【为专注场景设计】 护眼柔和配色，低刺激界面 可选粉噪 / 白噪 / 雨声环境音 触感反馈与每日提醒（可关闭） 中英文界面 【隐私优先】 训练记录、设置、成就全部存在你的设备本地 无需注册账号 支持 JSON 导出 / 导入备份 不采集个人身份信息的广告追踪 【重要说明】 Focus 是认知与注意力自助训练工具，不能替代专业医疗建议、诊断或治疗。如有 ADHD、焦虑、睡眠障碍等健康问题，请咨询持证医疗人员。 每天 10 分钟，开始你的专注训练。

6757666009.name: One Thing: Minimalist Todo App
6757666009.description: Too many tasks? That's the problem. One Thing is the anti-todo app. You can only add one task at a time. No backlog. No list. No prioritization. Just the one thing that needs your focus right now. When you have 20 things to do, your brain chooses to do nothing. One Thing removes that friction. Enter a task, and it stays on your screen—in-app, on your Home Screen widget, everywhere—until you're done. Sometimes priorities change. That's okay. Long-press to "Let Go" of a task without guilt. A short pause reminds you to be intentional, not impulsive. Features: One active task only—by design Home Screen widget with instant "Done" button Focus timer shows time spent "Let Go" for tasks that no longer matter History tracks your completed tasks and focus rate No account, no cloud, no tracking—100% private One Thing is for people who are tired of todo apps that become graveyards of good intentions. Do less. Finish more.

6782077919.name: 混凝土试块送检台账2026
6782077919.description: 混凝土试块送检台账是一款面向施工现场资料员、试验员和项目管理人员的本地效率工具。应用可离线记录试块批次、部位、强度等级、制作日期、养护方式、送检日期和报告结果，帮助用户减少手写台账遗漏。 适合日常管理标养、同条件、拆模等试块记录，支持按项目、楼栋、部位和状态筛选，自动计算7天、28天等常用龄期，并整理待送检、已送检、待报告、已归档清单。所有数据保存在本机，不需要登录，不联网，不收集个人信息。

6767005738.name: Crate for Plex
6767005738.description: Your Plex music library, finally given the iOS music player it deserves. Crate is a native, unofficial music player for your Plex Media Server, built for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and CarPlay. Pay once. No subscription. No ads. No tracking. Just your music, played beautifully. ON IPHONE Browse your entire library — albums, artists, playlists Now Playing reimagined with crossfade, queue, and hearts Discover view to rediscover albums you'd forgotten you loved Download albums for offline listening Smart caching keeps recently-played tracks ready offline Light and dark modes that actually look like iOS ON APPLE WATCH A real watchOS app — browse, download, and play from your wrist Doubles as a remote when your iPhone is the one playing Download albums directly to your watch Phone-optional playback with AirPods THE FUNDAMENTALS, DONE RIGHT Crossfade between tracks Shuffle with no repeats Hearts to track what you love Queue management you can actually use Lossless playback on iPhone (Apple Watch auto-transcodes for compatibility) WHAT'S NOT INSIDE No subscription No ads No tracking No login wall to a service that isn't yours Crate connects directly to your own Plex Media Server. Your music. Your server. Your player. REQUIREMENTS Crate requires a Plex Media Server with a music library and a free Plex account. Plex Pass is not required. Crate is an unofficial third-party application and is not made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Plex Inc.

6759053769.name: Eclipse Companion
6759053769.description: Your guide to the 12 August 2026 and 2 August 2027 Total Solar Eclipses. Eclipse Companion helps you choose where to watch, understand what you'll see, and stay ready on eclipse day. Designed for eclipse observers across Europe, North Africa, and the 2027 eclipse path, the app brings together precise local eclipse timings, totality path guidance, location comparison tools, live eclipse simulation, weather context, horizon checks, phase-specific reminders, and a home screen countdown widget in one focused experience. Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Romanian, with more languages planned. 6749773052.name: 物品收纳盒
6749773052.description: 收纳盒 - 智能家庭收纳管理应用 收纳盒是一款专为现代家庭设计的智能收纳管理应用，帮助您轻松管理家中的所有物品，让生活更加有序和高效。 核心功能： 1. 物品管理：添加、编辑和删除物品。 2. 位置管理：添加、编辑和删除位置。 3. 分类管理：添加、编辑和删除分类，对物品分类管理。 4. 房间管理：添加、编辑和删除房间，对位置信息进行细分。 5. 搜索功能：搜索物品、位置、分类和房间，快速找到您需要的物品。 6. 数据导出：导出物品、位置、分类和房间的数据。 7. 数据导入：导入物品、位置、分类和房间的数据。 特色功能： 1. 条码识别：通过条码扫描，快速查找物品、位置，或快速添加到收纳盒。 2. 图片识别：通过图片智能识别，快速查找物品。 3. 过期提醒：设置过期提醒，当物品快过期时，提醒您及时使用或更新。

6797524722.name: RunBuddy
6797524722.description: RunBuddy 是一款专为 Apple Watch 打造的完整跑步应用，不依赖 iPhone 也能独立开跑。实时心率、五级心率区间、GPS 路线、语音教练与训练计划，一腕掌握。你的所有跑步数据仅保存在设备本地，绝不上传。 完整独立的 Apple Watch 体验 无需携带 iPhone，抬手即跑，跑步全程由手表独立完成 实时心率监测 + 五级心率区间自动识别，颜色即强度 三级心率报警（Zone 4 警告 / Zone 5 危险 / 心率骤降），触感震动 + 中文语音 三种运动模式：路跑、越野、室内跑（室内无需 GPS） 自动暂停：停下自动暂停计时，重新起步自动恢复 表盘小组件（Smart Stack）：跑步状态实时可见，抬腕即知 每公里里程碑自动播报，语音 + 震动双反馈 专业级跑步数据 实时配速、距离、卡路里、步频、步幅、总步数 GPS 路线实时绘制，跑后大屏回放每一公里轨迹 海拔累计爬升 / 下降，真实反映赛道起伏 跑步动态深度指标：触地时间、垂直振幅、跑步功率 每公里配速列表，发现自己的节奏变化 训练负荷与恢复时间建议，科学安排下一次训练 VO₂max 最大摄氧量与血氧参考，了解心肺能力 趣味速度评级：乌龟 → 鸭子 → 兔子 → 狐狸 → 骏马 → 猎豹，见证进步 watch & iPhone 训练计划 内置课程：C25K 零基础 8 周计划、间歇跑（400/800/1000m）、节奏跑、燃脂跑 iPhone 端制定个性化训练计划：减肥 / 5K / 10K / 半马 / 全马 / 提升配速 今日训练一键下发至手表执行，手表端分段引导 语音实时教练：目标配速、剩余距离、段切换自动播报 跑步中 iPhone 锁屏 / 灵动岛实时显示距离、心率、配速与当前训练段 隐私优先，数据不上传 所有跑步数据仅保存在设备本地，通过 HealthKit 加密存储 不上传任何数据至服务器，完全离线可用 无账号、无广告、无追踪 戴上你的 Apple Watch，跑出属于你的速度之魂。

6792601149.name: いびきトラッカー：いびき録音・睡眠チェック
6792601149.trackName: いびきトラッカー：いびき録音・睡眠チェック
6792601149.description: いびきトラッカーは、寝ている間のいびきを自動で録音し、朝に「回数・時間・スコア」でまとめて見せてくれる、シンプルないびき録音アプリです。 枕元に置いてボタンを押すだけ。あとは画面を消しても、日付をまたいでも、朝まで録音は続きます。起きたら結果画面を開くだけで、その夜のいびきが一枚にまとまっています。 ■ こんな方へ ・家族やパートナーに「いびきがうるさい」と言われた ・自分がどれくらいいびきをかいているのか、まず知りたい ・お酒を飲んだ日、寝る向き、体重の変化で違いが出るのか比べたい ・病院や健康診断の前に、自分の記録を残しておきたい ・広告だらけ、サブスク前提の睡眠アプリに疲れた ■ できること 【ワンタップで自動録音】 就寝ボタンをタップして枕元に置くだけ。画面をロックしても録音は止まりません。日付をまたいでも途切れません。 【いびきスコア】 その夜のいびきの量を0〜100のスコアで表示。「静かな夜」「いびきが多めの夜」のように、ひと目で分かる言葉も添えます。 【くわしい数値】 総録音時間／いびき回数／いびき合計時間／いびき比率／最長いびき持続／最長静音区間を、一画面にまとめて表示します。 【時間帯別グラフ】 何時ごろにいびきが集中していたのかを、棒グラフで確認できます。 【タイムラインと再生】 検出したいびきや寝言だけを切り出して保存。気になる時間をタップすれば、その場で聞き返せます。一晩ぶんを全部聞く必要はありません。 【履歴】 日ごとのスコアと録音時間を一覧で保存。「昨日より良くなったか」がすぐ分かります。 【書き出し・共有】 記録を書き出して、家族との共有や、医療機関へ相談するときの材料として使えます。 ■ プライバシー 録音した音声も、解析した結果も、すべてお使いのiPhoneの中だけで処理します。外部サーバーへの送信はありません。アカウント登録もログインも不要です。不要になったデータは、アプリからいつでも削除できます。 ■ 料金 買い切りです。サブスクリプションも、追加課金も、広告もありません。 ■ ご注意 本アプリは、いびきの音を記録して振り返るための健康管理ツールです。医療機器ではなく、病気の診断・治療を行うものではありません。表示されるスコアや数値は目安であり、医学的な診断ではありません。気になる症状がある場合は、医療機関にご相談ください。 ■ 動作について ・録音にはマイクの使用許可が必要です ・一晩を通して録音するため、就寝中は電源に接続してのご利用をおすすめします ・録音データは端末の空き容量を使用します ・録音の保存期間は設定から変更できます

6767082054.trackName: 减烟记-戒烟减烟吸烟打卡记录健康省钱统计助手工具版
6767082054.description: 每天少抽一根，从减烟到戒烟，用减烟记轻松记录吸烟次数，看着数字一天天降低，直到彻底告别烟草。 设置每日目标，记录每一支烟的时间，查看省下的钱和身体恢复进度——不需要注册账号，数据只存在你的手机里。 【核心功能】 每日吸烟记录：带时间戳，一键打卡 省钱统计：实时计算戒烟后省下的金额 健康恢复时间轴：肺、心脏、循环系统逐步恢复 7天/30天趋势图表，一目了然 连续打卡天数与里程碑徽章 每日目标与超量提醒 纯离线运行，数据不上传 无论是逐步减量还是彻底戒断，减烟记都是你最诚实的戒烟伙伴。

6792650070.name: 央行数据-社融 M2 货币供应金融统计查询
6792650070.trackName: 央行数据-社融 M2 货币供应金融统计查询
6792650070.description: 央行官方统计数据一键查询工具，涵盖社融规模、M2/M1/M0 货币供应、外汇储备、黄金储备、人民币汇率、国债收益率、Shibor、CGPI、新增贷款、外汇占款等全量宏观经济与金融指标，月度同步更新，助力财经分析与投资决策。 【产品核心价值】 本应用同步中国人民银行官方发布的月度金融统计数据，将分散的央行报表结构化整合，可快速查阅全品类宏观经济指标，追踪数据走势，是金融从业者、投资者、财经研究者的必备数据工具。 【全覆盖指标体系】 货币供应类：M2 广义货币、M1 狭义货币、M0 流通中现金、基础货币、储备货币 社融信贷类：社会融资规模增量 / 存量、新增人民币贷款、住户 / 企业中长期贷款、政府 / 企业债券融资、票据融资、住户存款、各项存款合计 利率汇率类：Shibor 全期限、同业拆借加权利率、质押式回购利率、1/5/10/30 年期国债收益率、美元兑人民币汇率、SDR 兑人民币汇率 储备资产类：外汇储备、黄金储备、IMF 储备头寸、特别提款权 SDR 价格指数类：CGPI 企业商品价格总指数、农产品 / 矿产品 / 煤油电分行业指数 资本市场类：上证综指、深证成指、股票总市值 / 成交额 / 筹资额、债券发行额 / 余额 跨境资金类：境外机构持有境内债券、股票、存款、贷款 央行报表类：货币当局资产负债表、外汇占款、政府存款、央行总资产、货币发行 行业资产类：银行业 / 证券业 / 保险业总资产与总负债 产品功能亮点 【官方数据源】：同步央行月度发布数据，确保权威准确，更新及时 【结构化展示】：12 大类指标清晰分类，支持关键词快速搜索定位 【历史走势】：支持多期数据对比，直观把握数据变化趋势 【极简体验】：无广告、无冗余功能，专注高效数据查询 【离线可用】：已加载数据支持离线查看，随时随地查阅宏观数据

6737250915.name: Pet Translator - Human to Pet
6737250915.description: Pet Translator - Human to Pet is the perfect app for pet lovers who want to playfully communicate with their furry friends. Whether you have a cat or dog, this app allows you to translate human language into fun animal sounds like barks or meows. Enjoy a light-hearted experience as you 'talk' to your pet and see their reaction. Designed for entertainment purposes, Pet Translator - Human to Pet is easy to use. Simply speak into the microphone, and the app will convert your voice into sounds that mimic pet language. Share the fun with friends and family, and enjoy seeing how your pet responds to different sounds. Features: Translate human language into pet sounds such as meows Supports both cats, cow, and goat, with a variety of animal sound options User-friendly interface designed for all ages Ideal for playful interaction with your pet Important Information: Pet Translator - Human to Pet requires access to your device's microphone to function correctly. Please allow the necessary permissions when prompted. Disclaimer: The app is intended for entertainment purposes only and does not guarantee accurate translation of animal communication. The translations are meant to provide fun, not actual communication. Try Pet Translator - Human to Pet today and bring some fun to your pet's day!

6763554405.name: Face Scanner: AI Analysis
6763554405.description: ``` Face Scanner turns the TrueDepth camera on your iPhone into a facial measurement tool. Capture a 3D scan of your face in seconds, then explore every reference measurement used by plastic surgeons, oculoplastic clinicians, and facial aesthetics researchers. WHAT YOU CAN MEASURE Interpupillary distance (IPD) Intercanthal and outer canthal distance Palpebral fissure length and height (per eye) Canthal tilt (per eye and average) Alar base width Nasal length and Goode tip-projection ratio Nasolabial and nasofrontal angles Philtrum length, lower-face height, thirds ratio Ricketts E-line upper- and lower-lip offsets Bizygomatic width, bigonial width, FWHR Orbital vector (cornea vs infraorbital rim) Secondary ratios used in modern aesthetic analysis (IPD : bizygomatic, alar : IPD, philtrum : lower face, and more) 3D OVERLAY SYSTEM Every measurement can be toggled as a graphic overlay on your 3D scan. Angles show clear reference lines, arcs, and vertex anchors. Distances show landmark dots and a connecting line. Ratios show two distinct segments side-by-side. Tap multiple measurements to compare them on the same model, each in its own color. HISTORY AND TRENDS Every scan is saved locally on your device with its measurements. The history view lets you pick which measurements to track and see them across scans in a table or a line chart over time. Watch real progress without any guesswork. AESTHETIC-TARGET RATINGS Section-level ratings compare your measurements to documented aesthetic targets from Farkas's anthropometric norms, neoclassical canons, Ricketts' E-line, Peck & Peck's lower-third analysis, Goode's tip-projection ratio, and Powell & Humphreys' aesthetic face angles. Sources are cited in the Instructions screen so you always know which reference a number is compared against. PRIVACY FIRST Every scan stays on your device. Nothing is uploaded. Nothing is shared. No account required. WHAT'S FREE Unlimited 3D face scans Every visual measurement overlay In-app instructions with references WHAT UNLOCKS WITH PREMIUM ($4.99, one-time) Numeric values for every measurement Aesthetic-target rating per section Saved-scan browser Multi-scan history and trend charting One-time purchase — no subscription IMPORTANT Face Scanner is a measurement and tracking tool for personal reference and education. It is not a medical diagnostic device. Aesthetic target ranges are references, not goals. The app does not generate an "attractiveness score" and the developers intentionally avoid that framing. Requires an iPhone or iPad with a TrueDepth camera (Face ID capable).

6781155997.name: 跑团轮次助手TRPG骰子2026
6781155997.description: 跑团轮次是一款面向 TRPG 跑团、桌游战斗和线下主持的单机工具。玩家可以在本地创建遭遇，快速录入角色先攻，按回合推进战斗流程，并保存常用骰式与状态效果。 主要功能： 1. 先攻与轮次管理：创建遭遇、录入角色、按先攻排序、当前行动高亮、回合数自动累计。 2. 状态与持续时间：为角色添加中毒、眩晕、护盾等状态，设置持续回合，到期自动提示。 3. 常用骰式工具：保存 d20、d100、伤害骰、优势劣势等常用骰式，一键投掷并记录结果。 4. 遭遇档案保存：按战役保存敌人、玩家、备注和历史战斗记录，离线本地复用。 所有数据仅保存在设备本地，不需要登录、不联网、不收集用户数据，适合主持人在桌边长期使用。

6787367825.description: 专为托业备考打造的系统化单词学习工具 一、分层系统化课程规划 词汇分为基础、进阶两大阶段，每周划分固定学习单元，每单元明确词汇总量与学习天数，清晰展示完成进度，随时查看自身学习闭环。从入门基础商务词到高频职场考点词，循序渐进拆解记忆，适配零基础、冲刺提分等不同备考人群。 二、标准单词卡片记忆模式 还原高效卡片记忆逻辑，单卡完整覆盖单词原形、标准音标、中文释义、实用托业例句；内置真人标准发音播放按钮，点击即可听读，适配听觉记忆。支持隐藏释义自测、乱序复习、自动播放朗读、快速收藏生词，贴合碎片时间自主背诵需求。 三、多模式单词专项训练 配套两类针对性刷题训练，双向巩固记忆效果： 中文选义：根据中文释义匹配对应英文单词，夯实词义认知； 英文选义：看见英文单词匹配正确释义，强化单词快速反应能力。 双向刷题查漏补缺，告别 “看得懂、选不出” 的背诵痛点。 四、完整学习数据可视化 首页直观汇总全部学习数据：整体学习进度、累计完成学习天数、总核心词汇量、个人收藏生词库，所有学习成果一目了然，清晰见证备考成长，轻松规划每日学习任务。

6789836770.description: Every viral meme sound, one tap away. Meme Soundboard puts the internet's biggest sound effects — reactions, drops, brainrot, movie and game clips — right in your pocket, instantly playable with zero lag. HUGE SOUND LIBRARY Every viral meme sound in one place, organized into categories — Gaming, Movies, Brainrot, and more. New sounds are added constantly, so there's always something fresh to play. TRENDING See what everyone's playing right now. If a sound is blowing up, it's right at the top. SEARCH Know the sound you want? Find it in seconds — no endless scrolling through categories. FAVORITES Save your go-to sounds with one tap and build a personal collection you can always get back to. INSTANT PLAY Tap a sound, hear it immediately. No buffering, no waiting. FREE TO USE Play sounds, browse every category, and use search and favorites free, every day. MEME SOUNDBOARD PRO Every sound unlocked — the full library, every pack, every category, no daily limits New sounds first — fresh viral drops land in Pro before anyone else hears them Unlimited favorites — save every go-to sound, no cap on your collection No ads, ever — everything unlocks instantly SUBSCRIPTIONS Meme Soundboard Pro offers flexible plans to unlock premium features: Weekly · Monthly · Yearly · Lifetime (one-time) Prices vary by region and are shown in the app before purchase. 6474092236.name: The Lettervan
6474092236.description: 听音素并练习阅读和拼写！穿过带刺的藤蔓、饥饿的怪物和乌云——每个拼写的单词都有独特的动画。该应用程序是与言语和语言病理学家合作开发的，旨在帮助儿童认识到单词是由音素组成的。这种识别单词中音素的能力与发音、阅读和拼写的熟练程度密切相关。

6760980619.name: Compress & Upload for Safari
6760980619.description: Upload giant files to any site—instantly. Tired of websites rejecting your photos because they’re "too big"? This extension injects a "Smart Shrink" button directly into every upload box on the web. Compress, resize, and convert images before they even hit the server. How it works: Navigate to any website with an upload button. Look for the Downsize.pics icon that appears next to the file input. Select your image, dial in your size, and upload. It’s that simple. No more jumping between tabs, no more middle-man websites, and zero privacy compromises.

6760088305.name: HeartStash
6760088305.description: HeartStash 把 365 天储蓄挑战变成一款简单、可视的收集小游戏。 不再是一个抽象的大目标，你的年度储蓄被拆成 365 个小格子，排成心形。每天根据能存多少，任选一格「打卡」即可。 自定起始金额和每日递增，看着心形一点点被填满。无需账号、登录或云同步，数据都安全留在本机。 核心功能 自定义储蓄计划 设置计划名称、起始金额和每日步长，App 自动生成 365 个按等差数列排列的金额格子。 心形打卡网格 365 个格子排成心形，视觉激励强。点击未完成格子确认存入，长按已完成格子可撤销。 非线性储蓄 不要求按顺序。宽裕时选大额，紧张时选小额，所有进度都计入同一年度目标。 实时进度总览 在简洁的仪表盘查看已存总额、打卡天数、完成率和剩余金额。 每日本地提醒 设置每日提醒时间，让 HeartStash 温和提醒你打卡、保持连续。 CSV 导出与备份 将所有记录导出为 CSV（格子序号、金额、状态、日期），可分享到文件、邮件或聊天应用，便于长期复盘。 离线优先、隐私设计 100% 离线可用，数据用 SwiftData 存于本机，无服务器、无账号、无第三方统计。 多语言界面 支持多种语言（含中英文等），App 内即时切换。 HeartStash 为想用轻松、可视的方式养成储蓄习惯的人而做——一格一格，填满一颗心。

6737981488.name: Day & Night World Time Map
6737981488.description: Interactive world map showing day/night, local time, moon phases & planets. WulfTerra provides Earth related phenomena such as Sun, Moon and Planetary data, a compass locator and time and time-zone information for anywhere on the planet. All information is updated in real-time. No internet connectivity is required at all. The application contains no ads or distractions. No user or usage data is collected or used. The main display shows a live visualization of daylight, night and the various types of twilight. It also shows various metrics such as sunrise, sunset, altitude, solar noon, etc in relation to a fixed point on the Earths surface. The moon location, phase and various attributes for the major planets are shown in a separate panel, along with a mini-compass (if supported on the device) to help locating objects. A graphical orrery and plant-finder is also provided. A location on the Earth can either be selected manually or by using location services on the device. Feature Summary: Real-time displays of the Sun, Moon and major Planets. Real-time compass information (if supported on the device). Real-time day/night boundary (including all the types of twilight). Time-Zone information for the whole of the planet. Multiple data views (including Map, Dashboard and entity-by-entity). User can manually update the date and time to provide future or historical results. Times of sunrise and sunset for any location on Earth. Uses device location services to automatically set the users position. Various Sun metrics including sub-solar point, solar-noon, altitude above the horizon, distance from the Earth. Various Moon metrics including visual depiction of the moon and its location along with its current phase. Various Planet metrics including visual depiction of the planet and its location along with its current distance, magnitude etc. Multiple map types available. Markings for the equator, tropics, Arctic circle, Antarctic circle and meridian. Changes are saved and reloaded automatically. Tracking of the mouse (on Windows and MacOS) to provide information on any location in the world. Dashboard for planetary data.

6756326263.name: PratherPens Fountain Pen iD
6756326263.description: This app was created out of a personal need to inventory and identify a wide variety of pens—most notably fountain pens. What began as a simple organizational tool has grown into a broader vision: helping collectors worldwide keep track of their pen collections while also maintaining a rough estimate of each pen’s value. At the heart of the app is the Collection feature, which allows users to store photos, detailed descriptions, and historical notes about each pen. Alongside these records, the app provides an estimated value, giving collectors a practical way to monitor the worth of their collection over time. Whether you own a handful of cherished writing instruments or an extensive archive, the Collection feature is designed to make cataloging simple, visual, and informative. The app draws inspiration from the work of renowned pen collector and Parker 51 re-creator Ralph Prather, whose dedication to documenting and preserving pen history has influenced its design philosophy. His meticulous approach to his involvement in Fountain Pens serves as a guiding example for how this app seeks to empower collectors everywhere. As the app is still under active development, you can expect frequent updates and new features in the near future. Community feedback is central to its growth, so constructive suggestions and recommendations are always welcome. Every idea helps shape the app into a more valuable tool for pen enthusiasts across the globe. Please note that this app has NOT been tested on iPad or Apple Watch. Additionally, it HAS been tested on a variety of iPhones from 11 to 17, running iOS 18.x through 26.2. If you have any issues at all, please provide screenshots, video, and as much detail as possible to the support email and I'll be happy to troubleshoot with you. Your support on this project is very much appreciated! 10% of all proceeds go to the Disabled American Veterans organization (www.DAV.org) who provide assistance with benefits claims, transportation, and more.

6756326263.summaryDescription: This app was created out of a personal need to inventory and identify a wide variety of pens—most notably fountain pens. What began as a simple organizational tool has grown into a broader vision: helping collectors worldwide keep track of their pen collections while also maintaining a rough estimate of each pen’s value. At the heart of the app is the Collection feature, which allows users to store photos, detailed descriptions, and historical notes about each pen. Alongside these records, the app provides an estimated value, giving collectors a practical way to monitor the worth of their collection over time. Whether you own a handful of cherished writing instruments or an extensive archive, the Collection feature is designed to make cataloging simple, visual, and informative. The app draws inspiration from the work of renowned pen collector and Parker 51 re-creator Ralph Prather, whose dedication to documenting and preserving pen history has influenced its design philosophy. His meticulous approach to his involvement in Fountain Pens serves as a guiding example for how this app seeks to empower collectors everywhere. As the app is still under active development, you can expect frequent updates and new features in the near future. Community feedback is central to its growth, so constructive suggestions and recommendations are always welcome. Every idea helps shape the app into a more valuable tool for pen enthusiasts across the globe. Please note that this app has NOT been tested on iPad or Apple Watch. Additionally, it HAS been tested on a variety of iPhones from 11 to 17, running iOS 18.x through 26.2. If you have any issues at all, please provide screenshots, video, and as much detail as possible to the support email and I'll be happy to troubleshoot with you. 6788595011.name: 华夏岁时
6788595011.description: 华夏岁时 · 传承千年的日子 华夏岁时是一款以中国农历为核心的传统节日日历应用。它带你穿越时空，回到古人过节的现场，感受千年节令的仪式感。 农历日历 以农历为主、阳历为辅，清晰展示每日的农历日期、节气、传统节日。点击任意日期，即可查看当天的节日信息。 传统节日 收录春节、端午、中秋、重阳、除夕等所有中国传统节日，详细介绍每个节日的起源、传统习俗、历代诗词和顺时养生要旨。 二十四节气 完整收录二十四节气，每个节气都配有古时习俗和顺应天时的养生建议，让你像古人一样顺四时之序，养天地之气。 历代诗词 精选与每个节日、节气相关的经典诗词，配以注释和赏析。点击即可进入诗词详情，感受古人的诗意生活。 顺时养生 每个节日和节气都配有专属的养生建议，涵盖饮食、作息、运动、古法等方面，让你在传承文化的同时收获健康。 极简古风 界面采用宣纸底色与朱红点缀，营造沉浸式的古风阅读体验。完全离线运行，无广告，不收集任何用户数据。 华夏岁时——让每个传统日子，都有仪式感。

6736619440.name: 网球ACE - 网球专业运动AI记录分析
6736619440.trackName: 网球ACE - 网球专业运动AI记录分析
6736619440.description: TennisACE 包含什么功能？ 1.数据记录 网球ACE深度结合机器学习技术，判断自己的挥拍数据，包含正手、反手、发球、上旋、切削、挥拍速度、跑动距离等，同时获取体能数据、如卡路里消耗、运动时长、心率水平、HRV变异性心率、代谢当量等。 2.TennisAI分析功能 通过分析您上传的动作视频，将通过TennisAI分析动作标准程度，为您的动作进行打分，并根据不同维度给出提升建议。 3.图表分析展示 我们设计了多种多样的分析图表，可以直观明了的了解自己的运动情况，让运动数据化，数据可视化！图表包含五维能力分析、挥速统计、正反手分布、击球分布、心率统计、心率区间、年度统计等。 4.运动目标制定 您可以自由设定运动目标，比如运动时长、击球数、卡路里、跑动距离，让运动目标化、每一次挥拍都值得被量化！ 5.全球排行榜 您可以参与网球ACE排行榜，与全球小伙伴一较高下！排行榜按照不同周期（今日、本周、本月、本年、历史），排行榜类型（击球数、时长、挥速），性别（总榜、男生榜、女生榜）。排名类型多种多样，快来看看自己的水平吧！ 6.更多重磅功能，持续开发中！ 会员订阅自动续费说明： 周期：一个月或一年； 付款：确认购买并支付后，将通过您的iTunes账号自动续订； 取消续订：如需取消续订，用户可在当前订阅周期到期前24小时以前，随时手动在iTunes/Apple ID设置管理中关闭自动续费功能，取消后不再扣费； 续费：苹果iTunes 账户会在到期前24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个订阅周期。 使用条款：https://yujichengdu.wordpress.com/2024/11/06/%e6%9c%8d%e5%8a%a1%e6%9d%a1%e6%ac%be%e5%85%b7%e4%bd%93%e7%bb%86%e5%88%99%ef%bc%9a/ 隐私政策：https://yujichengdu.wordpress.com/2024/10/23/38/ 技术支持：https://yujichengdu.wordpress.com/2024/10/25/网球ace技术支持/

6757396957.name: Vagaloom: Bedtime Wind Down
6757396957.description: When your day is over but your mind and body are still moving, Vagaloom gives you one simple bedtime ritual instead of another content library to browse. Choose a starting point: Read the latest available heart-rate sample from Apple Health Enter a heart-rate reading manually Continue without heart rate and describe how you feel Heart rate is always optional, and no Apple Watch is required. Vagaloom uses your check-in to set the beginning of a focused soundscape, then moves gradually through Match, Transition, and Settle phases. It does not continuously monitor your heart rate or provide real-time biofeedback. After a session, record how you feel and optionally compare a newer heart-rate snapshot. Snapshots are brief context, not a medical assessment or proof of treatment. FREE Complete 5-minute sessions with no daily limit Apple Health, manual BPM, and subjective check-ins Your 3 most recent session records PRO LIFETIME One-time purchase — no subscription 5-, 10-, and 15-minute session options Complete session history Restore purchases through your Apple Account PRIVACY Session records stay on this iPhone. Vagaloom does not require an account, include advertising SDKs, or upload heart-rate snapshots to its own servers. Vagaloom is a wellness tool and not medical advice. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition.

6783103263.name: Ideon: Scroll Your Own Ideas
6783103263.description: Ideon is a private, scrollable feed for the ideas, links, files, concepts, terminology, and insights you want to keep. Capture an idea manually with text, photos, video, audio, or file attachments. Share links and supported files from other apps into Ideon, then keep everything in a simple personal feed you can revisit later. Ideon is built for the small pieces of knowledge that are too useful to lose: AI answers, articles, places, documents, diagrams, study notes, and real-life observations. Add related notes to older posts, connect follow-up thoughts, and let Ideon gently bring useful ideas back when they may be worth revisiting. There are no decks to organize, sessions to complete, or study streaks to protect. Pull to reshuffle, keep scrolling, search your library, and mark ideas as useful, fragile, or mastered to influence when they return. Features: A private feed for ideas, links, files, and notes Share links and supported files from other apps Manual posts with text, camera, photos, video, audio, and file attachments Related notes and comments for follow-up thinking Searchable concept library Gentle optional reminders for older saved ideas Subtle spaced-repetition weighting without flashcards Local storage for manually captured content No advertising or cross-app tracking Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://www.ideonapp.app/privacy/
