6758605905.name: RoastCam - Vibe Check
6758605905.description: ARE YOU DATING A WALKING RED FLAG? Welcome to RoastCam, the ultimate AI-powered Vibe Check. Whether you are investigating a suspicious crush, roasting your best friend, or just want to expose the truth, RoastCam is your pocket detective. We use advanced (and totally judgmental) computer vision to scan faces in real-time. The app analyzes micro-expressions and energy levels to generate a savage diagnosis instantly. WHAT ROASTCAM DOES AI FACE SCANNER Point the camera at a friend. Our scanner locks onto their face and "scans" their vibe using our proprietary, highly judgmental Red Flag engine. MICRO-EXPRESSION ANALYSIS The app detects facial features and simulates a high-tech analysis of their energy levels to generate a savage diagnosis instantly. SAVAGE DIAGNOSES Is he a Ghoster? Is she Toxic? The app reveals the brutal truth with 3D stickers and harsh titles. OFFICIAL SIMP LICENSES Once the scan is complete, generate an official Simp License. It includes their photo, offense, severity level, and restrictions. It looks like a real federal ID, perfect for group chats. VIDEO EVIDENCE Record the entire scanning process. The app saves a high-quality video with the diagnosis card overlay, ready to be shared on TikTok, Instagram, or Snapchat. KEY FEATURES Real-time face detection and tracking. Over 500 (!!!!!!!) unique Red Flags and personality traits. High-quality video recording with AR overlays. Customizable ID cards with randomized titles and restrictions. Instant sharing to social media. Haptic feedback and sound effects for maximum impact. HOW TO USE 1. Find a victim and point the camera at them. 2. Wait for the AI to lock on and analyze their soul. 3. Watch the verdict appear above their head. 4. Generate their Simp License and share it with the world. RoastCam is designed for entertainment purposes only. Please roast responsibly. DISCLAIMER RoastCam is intended for entertainment and comedic purposes only. While this app uses real Computer Vision technology for face tracking and detection, the "analysis" of micro-expressions, energy levels, and personality traits is a simulation generated for fun. No actual psychological or biometric evaluation is performed. Please roast responsibly.

6794994417.name: 班主任清单
6794994417.description: 班主任清单——专为中小学班主任大学辅导员打造的班级管理工具。 无论你是刚接手班级的新手班主任，还是需要提高日常管理效率的资深教师，都可以使用班主任清单，集中管理学生资料、日常记录和待办事项，让繁杂的班主任工作更有条理。 主要功能： 班级管理 支持创建、切换和管理多个班级，清晰记录年级、学年等信息。 学生档案 记录学生姓名、学号、性别、联系方式和备注，并支持批量添加学生。 日常记录 快速登记请假、违纪、表扬、家校沟通、待办及其他事项。 跟进提醒 记录后续跟进日期，集中查看需要继续处理的学生事务。 成长记录 按学生查看历史记录，帮助班主任持续了解学生在校情况。 数据统计 汇总班级近期动态和各类记录，让重要信息一目了然。 iCloud 同步 数据可通过个人 iCloud 在同一 Apple 账户的设备之间同步。 注重隐私 学生和班级数据保存在本机及用户个人 iCloud 中，不用于广告追踪。 班主任清单希望减少重复整理和纸笔查找，让每一次记录都有迹可循，让班级管理更加轻松、高效。 欢迎联系开发者提供建议：451143112@qq.com。

6790085548.name: No Contact Tracker: Move On
6790085548.description: No Contact Tracker – Move On Break free from unhealthy relationships and take control of your healing journey. Whether you're starting no contact, struggling with urges, or building a new life, this app provides everything you need to stay strong, track your progress, and grow every day. Track Your No-Contact Streak See your streak at a glance Watch your progress grow day by day Get motivated with milestones and achievements Never lose sight of how far you've come Daily Check-Ins Log your mood and urge levels each day Reflect on your feelings with a personal note See your weekly mood trends Build self-awareness and emotional resilience Journal Your Healing Write freely about your thoughts and feelings Add a mood to every entry Search and browse your journal history Export your journal as a PDF (Premium) SOS Mode – When the Urge Strikes Start guided breathing exercises to calm your mind Distract yourself with activities like music, walk, or call a friend Read powerful reminders of why no contact works Get immediate support right when you need it Achievements & Milestones Unlock badges for staying no contact (1 day, 3 days, 1 week, 1 month, and more) Celebrate every victory along the way Stay motivated with a visual roadmap of your progress Daily Affirmations Receive encouraging affirmations every day Strengthen your mindset and self-worth Tap to cycle through uplifting messages App Lock & Privacy Secure your journal with Face ID or passcode (Premium) Keep your healing private and safe Premium Upgrade Unlock the full experience with a Premium subscription: Unlimited journal entries and export to PDF Advanced SOS features and more distractions Unlimited bookmarks and highlights Ad-free reading and future premium content Unlock all achievements and milestones tracking Subscription Information Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. 6756681306.name: SleepTune: White Noise & Rain
6756681306.description: Discover your perfect soundscape with SleepTune. whether you are looking to improve your own sleep, focus on work, or help your baby drift off to dreamland, SleepTune provides the ultimate audio experience. Mix and match high-quality sounds to create your unique ambiance, or choose from our specialized library for relaxation and focus. CREATE YOUR OWN MIX Become your own audio engineer. Combine sounds simultaneously from our extensive library. Wide Variety: Choose from Rain, Nature, City vibes, Fans, ASMR, Melodies, and more. Precision Control: Adjust the volume of each individual sound to find the perfect balance. Save & Cloud: Save your favorite mixes to your personal library and back them up to the Cloud. EXPORT & SHARE Take your sounds with you! SleepTune allows you to render your custom mixes into 5-minute high-quality audio files. Export them to your files, share them with friends, or use them in other apps. SMART TIMER Drift off without worry. Set a custom sleep timer (from 5 minutes to 3 hours), and SleepTune will gently fade out the audio when the time is up, saving your battery while you sleep. Background Playback: Keep your audio playing while using other apps or when your screen is locked. Offline Support: Enjoy your favorite sounds without an internet connection. Download SleepTune today and rediscover the power of sound. Privacy Policy & Terms and Conditions: https://github.com/estersr/App-Policies

6759510427.name: Taiga: Anime & Manga Tracker
6759510427.description: Finally, a simple and fun way to keep track of every anime you’ve watched and every manga you’ve read. Whether you’re a casual viewer or a hardcore collector, Otaku List is here to help. Stop relying on messy notes or your faulty memory. We know that every fan has an opinion! That’s why we give you a personalized space to make the experience your own. Leave your personal comments, dish out your honest star ratings, and really make your profile a reflection of your taste. So, are you ready to level up your fandom? Dive in and have fun tracking your ultimate otaku journey! Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy: https://github.com/estersr/App-Policies

6776464449.name: Siloz
6776464449.description: Siloz 是一款离线优先的睡眠声音记录 App，帮助你在睡前开启录音，早起回顾卧室声音、疑似鼾声片段、分贝变化和个人趋势。它适合想了解夜间声音状态、整理睡眠记录、对比不同睡姿和睡前标签的人使用。 核心功能 睡前一键记录：记录夜间卧室声音，并在本机完成分析。 睡眠日报：查看呼噜值、记录时长、峰值分贝、重度鼾声次数和声音分布。 声音片段：快速回放疑似鼾声、梦话或环境声音片段，支持收藏和误判纠正。 趋势洞察：按近 7 天和近 30 天观察呼噜值、打鼾时长和重度鼾声次数变化。 标签对比：记录睡姿、饮酒、运动、咖啡、晚睡等睡前标签，观察不同夜晚的本地样本差异。 本机识别：声音档案和纠错记录用于辅助识别，帮助减少个人使用中的误判。 隐私控制：录音和分析结果默认留在本机，不自动上传；支持应用锁、隐私播放、录音保留时间和清理本机录音。 隐私与使用提醒 Siloz 不要求账号登录，不接入第三方统计 SDK，不做广告追踪。录音涉及你和附近人的声音，请在使用前确认附近人员知情并同意，且遵守当地规则。 Siloz 只用于个人记录和趋势观察，不是医疗设备，不提供诊断、治疗建议或疾病风险评估。如果你长期担心夜间呼吸或睡眠质量问题，请咨询合格医疗专业人士。

6775514489.name: TinyGPSEditor

6757842205.name: Video Upscaler
6757842205.description: Meet Video Upscaler, your ultimate AI-powered restoration studio that turns blurry, pixelated, or old media into breathtaking 4K masterpieces. Whether you are recovering vintage family memories, clearing up compressed downloads, or preparing raw camera footage for social media, this app uses advanced on-device neural networks to effortlessly enhance your photos and videos up to 4X magnification with a single tap. Why Choose This App? AI Upscale Engine: We don’t just stretch pixels. Our deep-learning models intelligently reconstruct lost details, sharpen edges, balance colors, and remove digital noise. Photo & Video in One: No need to jump between separate utilities. Seamlessly upscale both still images and motion videos in a unified, intuitive workflow. Real-Time Split Preview: See the magic happen instantly. Use our interactive slider to compare side-by-side Before & After results in real time before exporting. Ultra-Fast Processing: Optimized specifically for iOS and Apple Silicon. Experience lightning-fast processing times without melting your battery. Key Features at a Glance: 4X Resolution Upscaling: Transform low-res assets up to 4K resolution. AI Restoration: Intelligently reconstructs facial details, skin textures, and hair. Enhacing Levels: Adjust enhancing levels to produce the best result. No Quality Loss: Pristine, crystal-clear exports with zero compression artifacts. Privacy-First: Process files securely with maximum on-device efficiency.

6739962058.name: FauxChat - 聊天机器人制作器
6739962058.trackName: FauxChat - 聊天机器人制作器
6739962058.description: 一款支持同人创作、用户至上的界面故事生成器 我们直观流畅的界面让定制聊天对话变得轻而易举——无需任何技术技能。无论您想创作聊天小说、短信AU，还是让心仪角色展开天马行空的对话，FauxChat都能让您直接投入故事创作，尽情释放想象力。 无限叙事可能 精心设计对话的每个细节，完美契合您的创作构想。自定义聊天场景、参与者、用户名及消息内容，适配您钟爱的同人圈、AU世界观或原创角色阵容。 可扮演对话双方角色，全面掌控对话走向——无论是CP互动调侃、新组建的家庭群聊、充满忧郁的深夜私信，还是天马行空的脑洞对话小说，皆游刃有余。 添加表情符号、图片和动态反应，让虚构对话真实生动，宛如真实通讯软件中的交流。 导出与分享你的聊天小说 对话完成后，可将完整聊天记录导出为高清图片。完美适用于AO3、Wattpad、Tumblr、Twitter/X等平台分享，亦可保存用于灵感板、小说宣传或创意项目。 免责声明 FauxChat是一款创意叙事应用，专为构建角色间的虚构互动对话而设计。所有对话纯属虚构，仅限于同人创作、角色扮演及创意表达用途。严禁利用本应用欺骗、冒充或误导真实人物。本应用仅用于娱乐及故事创作目的。

6788614284.name: 疯狂坦克- FC经典版
6788614284.description: 棋盘还是老味道，坦克在格子里一格一格挪。 砖墙挡炮、钢墙不动、水域过不去——你得先转向，再贴线推进，看准角度一炮轰开通道。角落的老鹰基地不能丢，敌坦一波接一波；时间走到头，剩下的敌人会一起冲出来，那种压迫感，玩过的人都懂。 —— 竖屏选关，横屏开打 —— 首页竖屏看进度、挑关卡；一点「开始战斗」，全屏横过来，棋盘铺满屏。左边方向键管转向，点棋盘就往前走，右下角准星键开火——不用记复杂组合，上手就能轰。 —— 越往后，地图越刁钻 —— 从入门到硬关，砖墙迷宫、钢墙封锁、水域分割，敌坦数量和走位都会加码。首次安装自带逐步教学，设置里还能重看；进度存本机，下次接着闯。 —— 掌心里轰，腕上也能轰 —— 等电梯、等外卖那两分钟，抬腕就能接着上一关的进度。iPhone 上横屏大棋盘，砖墙钢墙看得清；Apple Watch 内嵌版表冠选关，十字键转向，点棋盘移动，准星开火，左滑退回——全在腕上。 —— 老味道，新棋盘 —— FC 风格像素绘制，砖墙、钢墙、水域、敌坦一个不少。音效开关、外观主题、进度记录都在应用里，打开就能玩。 联系：1350495119@qq.com

6777158029.name: 测亩仪助手 - 地图AR测量土地面积

6752805381.name: SmartBehavior
6752805381.description: SmartBehavior – Break free from unconscious habits Do you struggle with nail biting, skin picking, or touching your face without noticing? SmartBehavior helps you regain control. With advanced AI, SmartBehavior detects when your hand moves toward your face and alerts you in real time. This simple feedback makes you aware of unconscious behaviors – and gives you the chance to stop them before they happen. Key Features: Real-time detection: AI alerts you instantly when your hand touches your face Progress tracking: visualize improvements and stay motivated Custom alerts: choose sound or vibration notifications that fit your lifestyle Discreet and simple: runs in the background, works anytime you need it Whether you want to stop nail biting, skin picking, or other body-focused repetitive behaviors (BFRB), SmartBehavior gives you a powerful tool to build healthier habits step by step.

6793947556.name: The Odyssey by Homer
6793947556.description: THE ODYSSEY BY HOMER The journey that shaped every journey after it. The world is rediscovering The Odyssey. From the acclaimed Greek team that brought you “The Birds” by Aristophanes. A visionary director. An internationally acclaimed composer. A master illustrator. A distinguished dramaturg. A studio behind landmark cultural projects. Some of Greece's finest artists have joined forces on the land where the myths were born, to bring Homer home. THE ARTISTS Diamantis Karanastasis, director, actor & producer - creator and soul of the project. Stavros Gasparatos, internationally acclaimed composer - an original score performed on acoustic instruments. Ilias Sounas, designer & illustrator - a meticulously crafted 2D aesthetic born of ancient Greek art. Elena Triantafyllopoulou, distinguished theatrologist & dramaturg. Digital Innovation, the studio behind major successful cultural products. Every image, every note, every word, crafted like a work of art. THE JOURNEY Follow Odysseus from Troy to Ithaca. Face the Cyclops. Resist the Sirens. Encounter Circe and Calypso. Descend into the Underworld. Cross seas ruled by gods, monsters, and fate. Because the greatest challenge is not to survive, it is to return home. Listen to the story in English or Greek, as original illustrations, interactive moments, on-screen text, and music composed and performed with acoustic instruments bring Homer’s world to life. DISCOVER · PLAY · LEARN – Narration in English and Greek, more languages coming soon through free updates – Original illustrations rooted in ancient Greek art – Interactive moments in every scene – Original music performed on acoustic instruments – On-screen text throughout the experience – Optional pop-up TIPS: mythological, historical, etymological, linguistic, and interpretive insights. Explore them, or simply sail on. More languages are coming soon through free updates. The Odyssey is an adventure about intelligence, courage, loyalty, identity, and the enduring desire to return home. FOR EVERY AGE Children follow the adventure. Older readers discover the layers beneath it. And adults find themselves watching, listening, and moved. Accessible from the very first encounter. Rich enough to be rediscovered for a lifetime. AND THIS IS ONLY THE BEGINNING Ten more masterpieces of ancient Greek drama, tragedies and comedies by Aeschylus, Sophocles, Euripides, and Aristophanes, are complete and arriving soon. Same dream team. Same standard. One growing world of myth. COMING SOON: – Prometheus Bound by Aeschylus – The Persians by Aeschylus – Antigone by Sophocles – Oedipus Rex by Sophocles – Medea by Euripides – Helen by Euripides – The Bacchae by Euripides – Peace by Aristophanes – Plutus by Aristophanes – The Frogs by Aristophanes Discover the myth. Experience the journey. Return to Ithaca. Part of the Birigogo Collection of interactive journeys through Greek mythology and ancient drama. BIRIGOGO Interactive Educational Applications Explore Greek Myths, Tragedies, and Comedies. birigogo.com

6768790843.name: OL Reader
6768790843.description: OL Reader transforms your EPUB library into a personal listening experience powered by on-device AI. Import your favorite books and let the built-in Kokoro neural text-to-speech engine read them aloud with stunningly natural voices — no internet connection required, no subscriptions, and complete privacy. Whether you're commuting, cooking, or resting your eyes, OL Reader makes your entire ebook collection accessible as spoken audio. The AI runs entirely on your device using Apple's MLX framework, delivering high-quality narration without sending a single word to the cloud. Key Features: On-Device AI Narration — Kokoro neural TTS produces natural, expressive speech that sounds remarkably human. No network needed. Multiple Voice Options — Choose from a variety of voices to find the perfect narrator for every book. Smart Library Management — Import and organize your EPUB collection with ease. Browse covers, search titles, and pick up right where you left off. Memory-Efficient Reading Engine — An advanced chunking system with intelligent prefetching keeps scrolling buttery smooth, even for thousand-page novels. Seamless Read & Listen — Follow along visually with real-time text highlighting as the AI reads, or simply close your eyes and listen. Privacy First — All processing happens on your iPhone or iPad. Your books and reading habits never leave your device. Robust Text Handling — Gracefully handles complex Unicode, special characters, and even poorly formatted EPUBs without skipping a beat. OL Reader is perfect for avid readers who want hands-free access to their personal library, anyone with visual accessibility needs, language learners who benefit from hearing text read aloud, or multitaskers who want to enjoy books while on the go. Turn every moment into reading time — your books have never sounded this good.

6758230068.name: 再点一下试试
6758230068.description: 再点一下试试是一款帮助你控制应用使用的工具，通过系统级的应用封印功能，你可以限制日常容易沉迷的应用。当尝试打开被封印的应用时，会显示自定义锁屏界面，给你一个冷静思考的机会。你可以为每个应用设置定时解锁，不遵守契约会受到惩罚。应用会记录你每次的抵抗和妥协行为，生成意志力指数，并以图表形式展示今日、本周、本月的数据变化。连续成功自律的天数会被记录，激励你保持良好的使用习惯。所有数据仅存储在本地，保护你的隐私。 核心功能： 1. 硬核封锁模式，自定义需要屏蔽的 App 列表（游戏、社交、短视频）。一旦进入专注时间，应用图标将被强制遮盖，无法打开，无法绕过。物理隔绝多巴胺来源。 2. 失败行为追踪，记录你的“破戒”次数。精准统计你在何时、何地、试图打开几次违禁 App。正视软弱，才能真正变强。 3. 极简与高效，波普艺术风格设计，黑红高对比度界面。没有复杂的设置，一键开启，即刻进入心流状态。 适用人群： 需要极度专注的考研/考公党：无法控制刷短视频时间的重度用户：希望改善睡眠质量的熬夜族。 你的时间非常值钱，别把它浪费在无意义的滑动上。

6790423528.name: Fishtail
6790423528.description: Fishtail is a generative MIDI instrument for iPhone and iPad. It composes complete musical forms, then lets you shape, perform, retain and rearrange them! Fishtail does not use AI to generate music. Its musical output is created through algorhythmic generation grounded in musical theory. Build pieces from sections with independent keys, modes, meters, cadences and expressive treatments. Generate distinct Takes, compare them, reorder them and hand the next Take over at a natural whole-piece boundary. Fishtail produces MIDI rather than sound. Use it standalone or as an AUv3 MIDI plug-in, and route its seven musical channels to the instruments you choose. Ableton Link supports shared tempo and transport. Features: Complete multi-section generative compositions Seven-channel MIDI output Retain, reorder and perform Takes Seven intonation systems Normal MIDI, pitch-bend and MPE output MTS output Ableton Link .fishtail project save and recall Standard MIDI and per-channel export Experimental analogue CV file packages Accessible light and dark interfaces No account, advertising, analytics or tracking. Tested in AUM

6797875277.description: 打完一场球，最想留下的往往就是那几个来回。可它们总是发生在没人举着手机的时候。 羽球迹是一款给单打和单人练球用的羽毛球记录工具，只做两件事：数清你的每一拍，以及把你打出的多拍回合自动剪成视频。 ■ 只在多拍回合才录，不用自己剪 把手机横放架在场边，正常打球就行。当一个回合的连拍数达到你设定的门限，羽球迹会自动把这个回合从头到尾截出来，加上「羽球迹 · X 连拍高光 · 日期」水印，存进系统相册里名为「羽球迹高光」的专属影集。 不用事后翻一小时录像找片段，也不用剪辑软件。下场打开相册就能直接分享。 门限默认 8 连拍，可在设置里 5 到 20 之间调整：想多留一点就调低，只想留精华就调高。 ■ Apple Watch 数清每一拍 戴上 Apple Watch 开始记录，手表以 100Hz 采集手腕姿态，识别挥拍动作并换算击球速度。 每场自动记录：挥拍总数、最高球速、单回合最长连拍、杀球数、高远球数，以及正手 / 反手 / 头顶 / 下手四类动作的次数分布、运动时长与消耗卡路里。 ■ 个人纪录长期追踪 所有场次汇总成个人战报。最高球速、最长连拍这些纪录会一直跟着你，练了几个月到底有没有进步，数据说话。 ■ 数据是你自己的 高光视频只存在你的手机相册里，我们不上传、不备份，也看不到任何影像。 手表原始传感器数据只在设备上实时处理，不离开设备。 不收集位置信息，不接第三方分析与广告 SDK，没有开屏广告。 可以完全不登录使用，以本机游客身份记录；换手机时再用 Apple ID 登录，之前的记录会自动归到你的账号下。 ■ 适合谁 固定约球、想知道自己一场打了多少拍的球友 单人多球练习、想回看自己动作的人 想把场上那几个精彩来回留下来，又懒得剪视频的人 ■ 使用前请知悉 挥拍与球速统计需要 Apple Watch（watchOS 9.0 或更高版本，Series 4 及以后机型）。只装 iPhone 端无法采集动作数据。 高光录制期间手机需停留在「精彩画面」页保持取景，锁屏或切到其他 App 会中断。 首次使用需要授予相机、麦克风、相册以及运动与健身权限。 挥拍统计只看你自己手腕的动作，与场上人数无关；但高光片段按你个人的连拍节奏截取，因此更适合单打和单人练球。 有问题或建议，欢迎邮件联系：wxin4744@gmail.com 技术支持：https://wolongzhigang.com/support/

6791957749.name: ZenFocus: Attention Trainer
6791957749.description: ZenFocus is an attention and focus trainer with 12 short, science-backed mini-games. Practice visual search, response inhibition, sustained attention, and working memory—usually in 1–3 minutes per session. TRAININGS Schulte Grid — tap numbers in order (visual search) Impulse Brake — go on green, stop on red (Go/No-Go) Color-Word — name the ink, ignore the word (Stroop) Focus Wheel — steady rotation + signal responses Dual Color, Pursuit Rotor, Sum Split Memory Flip, Reverse Swipe, Schulte Words Memory Chase, Pair Match WHY ZENFOCUS Classic cognitive paradigms, not gimmicks Local scores with trends and ability breakdown No account, no ads, no tracking—data stays on device English and Chinese, built for iPhone and iPad Open ZenFocus and make focus a daily habit, a few minutes at a time. — ZenFocus Pro is an auto-renewable subscription (weekly / monthly / annual) unlocking all 12 trainings and unlimited sessions. Payment is charged to your App Store account and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in App Store account settings. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://cloudsjhan.github.io/zenfocus-privacy-policy/ Support: https://cloudsjhan.github.io/zenfocus-support/

6502905400.name: XRateAverage
6502905400.description: XRateAverage 以前所未有的精确度、简便性以及全新的智能游戏化体验 (Gamified Experience)，彻底改变了您跟踪和分析汇率的方式。 无论您是在管理国际业务交易、规划海外投资、跟踪旅行开支，还是单纯地观察全球市场，XRateAverage 都能为您提供全方位的货币情报，帮助您做出自信的财务决策。 XRATEAVERAGE 全新功能： 互动成就系统 让财务跟踪变奖励丰厚的旅程！在 5 个类别中赢取 43 个独特的徽章。通过计算、每日连胜、发现隐藏功能以及研究特定货币来解锁成就。实时查看进度百分比，并在升级时享受炫目的动画弹出通知。 个性化使用统计 以前所未有的方式了解您的财务行为。全新的动态仪表板为您提供关于常用货币、活跃高峰时段和功能使用模式的实时见解——一切均基于您的真实数据。 收藏夹仪表板 保存您最常用的货币对，实现即时访问。个性化仪表板会跟踪您保存的货币对的统计数据，让您只需轻点一下即可获取重要见解。 智能工作日通知 绝不错过市场波动。设置专门针对实际工作日（周五的数据可完美用于周一）的上午 10 点实时警报，确保您在市场最重要的时刻获得最精准的汇率更新。 安全账户同步 您的数据将得到妥善保护并完美同步。通过全新的 Supabase 驱动身份验证，您可以在不同设备间安全保存您的偏好、历史计算记录和成就。 强大的核心功能： 智能平均计算 即时计算任意两个日期之间的精确平均汇率。非常适合税务报告、投资分析和财务规划。 多货币支持 访问包括美元 (USD)、欧元 (EUR)、英镑 (GBP)、日元 (JPY)、澳元 (AUD)、加元 (CAD)、瑞郎 (CHF)、土耳其里拉 (TRY) 等在内的全球主要货币的实时及历史数据，并配有高质量的视觉国旗图标。 月度趋势分析与可视化图表 通过动态、流畅的图形按月查看汇率模式。利用响应式触摸控制进行缩放、平移和探索汇率波动。 无障碍与个性化舒适度 为您双眼量身定制。在清晰的藏青色亮色模式与优雅的冰蓝色暗色模式之间动态切换。调整文字粗细、启用高对比度或触发减弱动态效果设置，打造您的理想浏览体验。 极速性能 优化后的算法即使在复杂的日期范围内也能确保实现即时计算。 谁能从 XRATEAVERAGE 中受益？ 商务人士：跟踪国际交易成本，准备准确的财务报告，并优化换汇时间。 投资者与交易员：分析外汇市场趋势，计算投资组合表现，并寻找新机会。 常旅客：精确制定旅行预算，以本地货币跟踪支出，并寻找完美的兑换窗口。 财务团队：为会计期间生成精确的平均汇率，并确保合规性准确无误。 自由职业者与跨境电商：进行数据驱动的定价，监控利润率，并设置稳健的远程办公支付方案。 XRateAverage 将复杂的货币数据转化为清晰、可执行的见解。精密的计算引擎在精美的用户界面后完美运行，让专业级的货币分析触手可及。 隐私政策：https://adburbs.com/xrateaverage/privacy-policy.html 服务条款：https://adburbs.com/xrateaverage/terms-of-service.html

6755909295.name: WatchDictApp
6755909295.description: WatchDict is an offline dictionary and reference app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Create and manage your own entries as simple JSON files, keep separate Master and Owner dictionaries, and send the one you want to Apple Watch for offline use. The watch keeps the last dictionary you sent, so your information stays available whenever you need it. Key Features ・Offline dictionary on iPhone and Apple Watch ・Manage two dictionaries: Master and Owner ・Send one selected dictionary to Apple Watch ・Store dictionaries as simple JSON files ・Import, export, back up, and restore your data ・Fast search and easy review of saved entries

6446226378.name: NearSend
6446226378.description: NearSend 发送设备上的数据给身边的其他设备，操作可以很简单。 不用在互联网环境下，也不用在 Wi-Fi 环境下，只需要打开设备的蓝牙即可。 支持发送文件夹、图片、视频、文件、音频等各种格式。 支持 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 多平台，让数据分享变得更加轻松、便捷、随时随地。

6775334158.name: Nogmi：录音·转写·总结
6775334158.description: Nogmi 是一款录音、转写并总结会议、讲座和访谈的应用。 从录音到 AI 总结，所有处理都在设备本地完成。无需联网，也不会上传到服务器。 ■ 轻点一下即可开始 无需复杂设置即可开始录音。录音结束后，转写和总结会依次准备就绪。 ■ 100 种语言的设备端转写 WhisperKit 模型会自动识别说话语言并准确转写。即使中英文混说，也能分别准确转写。即使网络中断，转写也会继续。 ■ 5 种契合用途的 AI 总结 设备端 LLM 会分析转写内容，只提炼出要点。 会议纪要 — 聚焦与会者发言、决定事项和待办事项 讲座录音 — 按主题分节，分层呈现核心概念与示例 通用总结 — 按整体摘要、要点、细节的顺序 头脑风暴 — 将想法列成清单并分类整理 访谈 — 问答匹配与洞见提炼 ■ 在所有设备上，自动同步 在 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和 Apple Watch 之间继续同一段录音。用 Apple Watch 快速录音，并通过 iCloud 云盘自动同步到所有设备。在 Mac 菜单栏用快捷键（⌘⇧R）即可立即录音。 ■ 隐私是默认设置 录音、转写、总结的任何环节都不会有外部服务器介入。录音内容只保存在你的设备和你的 iCloud 中。 ■ 轻松聆听，从容整理 借助 0.75 倍至 2.0 倍播放速度、15 秒快进以及带时间码的转写，快速找到想要的片段。转写文本可直接编辑，还能通过锁屏小组件和控制中心一键开始录音。 首次启动时会一次性下载总结模型（约 2GB）。建议在 Wi-Fi 环境下进行。

6764813079.name: VitaJournal
6764813079.description: VitaJournal 是一款简洁完整的健康日志,把体重、饮食、力量训练、有氧、心情和日记汇集在一个安静的空间。无广告。无外部服务器。所有记录只保存在你的设备里。 ■ 可以记录的内容 体重与体脂率 一键数字键盘输入,自动预填上次数值,±0.1 / ±0.5 kg 快速调整。可选择写入 HealthKit。 饮食 按食物逐行记录千卡、蛋白质、钠、饮水量或任何你关心的指标。合计自动计算。常吃的搭配可保存为「套餐」,一键再次添加。 力量训练 记录动作、组数、重量、次数。上一次的数值就显示在今日输入旁边,便于追踪渐进负荷。完整训练日 (Push day、Pull day、Leg day) 可保存为模板复用。按部位、地点或你的习惯自由打标签。 有氧 步数自动从 HealthKit 同步,可添加自定义有氧 (跑步、瑜伽、普拉提等)。 自定义追踪 饮水量、冥想分钟、补剂、睡眠质量、屏幕时间…… 可自由添加单位和分类。 心情与日记 1–5 级身体状态评分加自由文字。按日期回看过往记录。 AI 复盘导出 将一周的记录导出为整洁、可粘贴的文本,投喂给 ChatGPT、Claude 或其他对话 AI,获得教练级的训练量、营养、恢复反馈。 趋势 体重、训练量、卡路里、心率、睡眠、HRV 等多项指标的可调时间窗口图表。 HealthKit 步数、睡眠、静息心率、HRV、活动能量自动导入。所记体重可回写到 HealthKit。 备份 可导出到任意文件夹 (含 iCloud Drive),便于换机或长期存档。 ■ 隐私优先 VitaJournal 不会将数据发送到我们的服务器 —— 因为没有服务器。所有数据本地存储,仅在你选择时通过 Apple iCloud 同步。无统计分析、无广告 SDK、无追踪。AI 导出每次都需要你主动选择,你决定什么内容离开 App、去往哪里。 ■ 支持语言 简体中文、英语、日语、德语、法语、西班牙语、韩语。

6789752669.name: 贯口练习器-相声台词提词本2026
6789752669.trackName: 贯口练习器-相声台词提词本2026
6789752669.description: 贯口练习器是一款面向相声爱好者、曲艺社团、艺考生和舞台表演者的离线练习工具。用户可以建立贯口和绕口令台词本，按段落拆分练习，使用遮挡背诵、提词模式、计时练习和错句标记来提高熟练度。所有内容仅保存在本机，无需登录、无需联网，适合长期积累个人演出素材和练习记录。

6753601596.name: Japan Eats
6753601596.description: Japan Eats 帮你决定在日本吃什么。 浏览一份配有大量照片的美食指南，收录 480+ 种日本料理、饮品、甜点和地方特色美食。每个条目都包含简短易读的介绍、日文名称、主要食材以及常见吃法，帮助你在菜单上认出菜品，并更有信心地点餐。 找到想尝试的食物后，可以使用“附近查找”在 Apple 地图或 Google 地图中按具体菜品搜索。 功能 收录 480+ 种日本食物和饮品的视觉化图鉴 拉面、寿司、荞麦面、乌冬面、盖饭、居酒屋料理、烤鸡串、甜点、茶饮等 英文和日文菜名，并配有简短说明 附近查找：按菜品在 Apple 地图或 Google 地图中搜索 给店员看：显示简单用餐请求，例如不要辣或双份 适合旅行、餐厅、美食广场、市场和查看菜单时使用 语言 English, 日本語, Русский, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Português (BR), Español (MX), 한국어, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, Français (FR) 注意：地图可用性和搜索结果可能会因地点和时间而异。

6792435964.name: Shadow101：英语跟读 新概念英语
6792435964.trackName: Shadow101：英语跟读 新概念英语
6792435964.description: 通过专注的影子跟读练习，逐步提升英语听力、发音、节奏和口语表达。 Shadow101 让你逐句听原音、反复练习、录下自己的声音，并长期记录学习进度。你可以完整跟读一篇课程，也可以专注练习一句话，直到熟悉它的发音、节奏与表达。 灵活的跟读方式 逐句播放课程原音 支持单句循环、单课循环和连续播放 自由调整播放速度 快速切换上一句和下一句 快速切换上一课和下一课 随时切换英文或中英双语文本 录音并进行对比 你可以为每一句话录下自己的跟读，分别播放原音和个人录音，发现发音、节奏与语调上的差别。每句话保留最近一次录音，方便反复练习。 清楚了解学习进度 记录每课的跟读次数 通过日历查看每天的学习情况 查看每周趋势与连续学习天数 找到练习次数最多的课程 设置每日跟读提醒 更多学习工具 课程词汇与发音 四个循序渐进的学习级别 分享课程音频和文字 支持英文、简体中文和繁体中文界面 适合离线学习 每天练习一点，从一句话开始，让英语表达逐渐变得自然。
